agentSkills.description: Use when a named or suspected competitor must be positioned against customer requirements, decision criteria, or objections for a specific opportunity. Not for generic market research or unsupported competitor claims.

agentSkills.description: Use when a bounded set of sales records needs an evidence-based review for absent, malformed, stale, inconsistent, or unverified data and a proposed correction report. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-crm-data-hygiene

agentSkills.description: Use when an account needs a phased engagement plan across stakeholders, coverage gaps, relationship paths, and business objectives. Use a 30-day horizon when requested; not for choosing only the immediate next buyer.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-customer-engagement-strategy

agentSkills.description: Use to report what changed and why across a scoped set of deals since a stated baseline — which deals slipped, or what moved on a bounded top set since a point in time. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-desk

agentSkills.description: Use when a seller or manager needs to test an alleged slowdown on one specific opportunity and decide whether it is a supported stall, a record-hygiene issue, or not currently supported by the evidence, then recommend recovery, restructuring, escalation, or disqualification. Not for a change digest across many deals, a leadership status review, cross-set ranking, or an ordinary healthy-deal lookup.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-rescue

agentSkills.description: Use to draft outreach for people the seller met whose pending asks need follow-up, or previously responsive open leads that have gone quiet. Ground drafts in substantive evidence and assess the contact policy for the actual purpose and channel. Produces reviewable text; saving or sending requires a separate, explicitly approved action. Not for a completed meeting's summary and action capture, choosing the next stakeholder, or cold prospecting.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-draft-outreach

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity needs a leadership-ready review of current state, material movement over a defined period, risks, decisions, and a specific leadership ask. Not for a team-wide pipeline review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-executive-deal-review

agentSkills.description: Use when one lead needs an evidence-backed assessment against an explicitly supplied qualification method, including criterion-level gaps, a disposition recommendation, and proposed routing. Not for inventing BANT, forcing a binary decision, or configuring an existing opportunity.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-lead-disposition

agentSkills.description: Use before one customer meeting or sales interaction to prepare an evidence-backed objective, participant brief, relevant context, open commitments, agenda, questions, talking points, risks, and desired outcomes. Works from supplied material; not for post-meeting capture, a phased account plan, or a seller's coaching agenda.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-meeting-prep

agentSkills.description: Use to produce a ranked worklist of which opportunities in a scoped set to work next and why now, weighing value, urgency, risk, momentum, and influenceability. Needs a defined opportunity scope and current opportunity evidence; a live engagement history improves the read but is not required. Not for reporting what changed on a set of deals, a single meeting brief, or a full team pipeline review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-pipeline-prioritizer

agentSkills.description: Use after one sales meeting or call to separate facts, decisions, commitments, and open topics; propose durable record updates and next actions; and draft follow-up communication when requested. Not for a broad account history or work-period capture.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-post-meeting-follow-up

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity's recorded representation needs to be compared with dated business evidence to identify drift, stale or incomplete values, contradictions, and unsupported claims. Works without current record access as a bounded observations report; not for a wide hygiene sweep.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-reconcile-my-opportunity

agentSkills.description: Use when an opportunity must be evaluated against explicit organizational requirements for a defined next stage, with each criterion marked met, unmet, unknown, or conflicting. Not for inferring readiness from a stage label or activity volume.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-stage-advance-readiness

agentSkills.description: turn sales, customer, usage, value, pipeline, and financial data from crm systems, excel workbooks, and other connected sources into one or more executive-ready powerpoint slides. use to visualize data, create charts or scorecards, add data-driven insights to a deck, update existing slides with current metrics, compare customers or periods, explain business performance, or build an executive sales narrative from quantitative data.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-visualize-sales-data

agentSkills.description: Use this skill first for creating a source-grounded internal account brief for a named customer or prospect - what matters to the customer, who matters in the decision, where we stand, which opportunities to validate, and what to do next. Saves an editable PowerPoint deck. Use for requests such as "create an account brief for Northstar", "build a briefing deck on this customer for our sales team", "make an account briefing deck from these notes and filings", or "prepare a prospect brief". Do NOT use for creating login or user accounts, preparing for one upcoming meeting or call unless a deck is asked for, customer-facing sales pitches, QBRs or adoption reviews, annual account plans with quotas or pipeline forecasts, summarizing or fact-checking an existing deck, drawing a reporting hierarchy alone, briefs wanted as a Word, PDF, or Markdown file, or research answered in chat with no brief file requested. For matching tasks, load this skill before any generic PowerPoint/presentation skill.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-account-brief

agentSkills.description: Create a buyer-specific proposal or bid presentation responding to explicit requirements or an RFP, with coverage, evidence, delivery, commercials and limits. Use for "respond to the buyer's requirements" or "prepare our RFP proposal deck". Do NOT use for a proactive customer product or solution pitch, investor pitches, customer business reviews, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-proposal-response

agentSkills.description: Required for general-purpose customer Pitch Decks: cold first meetings, warm-lead product introductions, industry pitches, and internal enablement. Use for "pitch our product to a new buyer" or "introduce our solution". Do NOT use for formal RFPs or buyer-requirement proposals, investor/fundraising pitches, QBRs, account plans, pipeline reports, or edits.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-sales-pitch

agentSkills.description: Use when the user explicitly requests a sales results or forecast summary deck for senior leadership, highlighting expected outcomes, material risks and decisions requiring executive support. Use for "build a sales results deck for our leaders" or "create forecast summary slides for the VP". Do NOT use for forecast or pipeline analysis answered in the conversation, one opportunity's leadership review unless a deck is asked for, deal-by-deal pipeline management, customer-facing business reviews, proactive pitches, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-executive-sales-summary

agentSkills.description: Prepare a seller to handle a specific customer''s likely objections. For each objection: the customer''s wording, discovery questions to ask live, a short evidence-backed response, the proof behind it or the evidence still missing, and a confirming next step. Delivered by default as a separate internal deck, or as removable slides appended to the current deck or kept in chat when the user asks. Use when the user asks to "prep me for this customer''s objections", "how do I answer their pushback on price", "build objection handling for this deal", "what will the buyer push back on and how should I respond", "objection responses for the concerns they raised on the call", or "talk tracks for handling procurement''s objections". Do NOT use to stress-test, score or find weaknesses in a presentation''s own argument, to play devil''s advocate, for general Q&A rehearsal, to write speaker notes or a talk track for the deck itself, or to build or redesign a pitch.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-prepare-objection-responses

longDescription:
Get sales context and actions where you already work—so you can focus on customers, follow up faster, and move deals forward.

Sales brings the Sales agent to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook, and Teams for users of Dynamics 365 Sales and Salesforce CRM. The package also includes the Dynamics 365 plugin for the Copilot app.

Use Sales to prepare for customer meetings, catch up on deals, draft relevant follow-ups, and get AI-generated insights and recommendations. Sales connects to Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce CRM to provide sales data and capabilities in these experiences.

Salesforce users require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Dynamics 365 Sales users require eligible Dynamics 365 licensing. Administrator setup is required, and access to specific experiences depends on the user’s licensing, entitlement, and access to the relevant Microsoft product.

**Setup and data handling**

Sales allows administrators and users to access content and share data outside of Microsoft 365, including with third-party customer relationship management (CRM) services. Such data sharing is subject to Microsoft and applicable third-party CRM terms and conditions. Data sharing is not enabled until administrators and users in your organization consent to connect their Microsoft work or school account with their CRM account.

Sales in Microsoft 365 Copilot will have permission to participate in Microsoft Teams meetings and collect Teams meeting data such as meeting recordings and transcripts.

When deployed by an administrator, Sales will have permission to automatically review email and appointment recipient lists when sending emails or creating or modifying appointments. This supports actions such as suggesting new contacts for addition to the CRM system and displaying relevant CRM information.

**Discover more:**
- [Explore what’s possible with Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Sales FAQ](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
احصل على سياق المبيعات وإجراءاتها في المكان الذي تعمل فيه بالفعل، حتى تتمكن من التركيز على العملاء، والمتابعة بشكل أسرع، ودفع الصفقات إلى الأمام.

يوفر Sales عامل المبيعات" في Microsoft 365 Copilot، وOutlook، وTeams لمستخدمي Dynamics 365 Sales وSalesforce CRM. تتضمن الحزمة أيضًا المكون الإضافي Dynamics 365 لتطبيق Copilot.

استخدم Sales للاستعداد للاجتماعات مع العملاء، والاطلاع على آخر الصفقات، وصياغة رسائل المتابعة ذات الصلة، والحصول على نتائج التحليلات والتوصيات التي ينشئها الذكاء الاصطناعي. يتصل Sales بـ Dynamics 365 Sales أو Salesforce CRM لتوفير بيانات المبيعات وإمكاناتها في هذه التجارب.

يحتاج مستخدمو Salesforce إلى ترخيص Microsoft 365 Copilot. يحتاج مستخدمو Dynamics 365 Sales إلى ترخيص Dynamics 365 مؤهَّل. يلزم إعداد المسؤول، كما تعتمد إمكانية الوصول إلى تجارب معينة على ترخيص المستخدم، واستحقاقه، وإمكانية وصوله إلى منتج Microsoft ذي الصلة.

**الإعداد والتعامل مع البيانات**

يتيح Sales للمسؤولين والمستخدمين الوصول إلى المحتوى ومشاركة البيانات خارج Microsoft 365، بما في ذلك خدمات إدارة علاقات العملاء (CRM) التابعة لأطراف خارجية. تخضع مشاركة البيانات هذه لأحكام وشروط CRM المعمول بها التابعة لـ Microsoft وأطراف خارجية. إن مشاركة البيانات غير ممكّنة حتى يوافق المسؤولون والمستخدمون في مؤسستك على إنشاء اتصال بين حساباتهم المتعلقة بالعمل أو المؤسسة التعليمية في Microsoft وحساباتهم المتعلقة بـ CRM.

سيحصل Sales في Microsoft 365 Copilot على الإذن بالمشاركة في اجتماعات Microsoft Teams وجمع بياناتها، مثل تسجيلات الاجتماع ونُسخها المكتوبة.

وعندما يوزع أحد المسؤولين Sales، فسيحصل Sales تلقائيًا على الإذن بمراجعة قوائم مستلمي البريد الإلكتروني والمواعيد عند إرسال رسائل بريد إلكتروني أو إنشاء مواعيد أو تعديلها. ويدعم ذلك إجراءات مثل اقتراح جهات اتصال جديدة لإضافتها إلى نظام CRM وعرض معلومات CRM ذات الصلة.

**اكتشاف المزيد.**
- [استكشاف ما يمكن تحقيقه باستخدام Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [الأسئلة المتداولة حول Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [وثائق Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Получавайте контекст и изпълнявайте действия, свързани с продажбите, там, където вече работите – за да се съсредоточите върху клиентите, да предприемате последващи действия по-бързо и да придвижвате сделките напред.

„Продажби“ предоставя агента за продажби в Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook и Teams за потребителите на Dynamics 365 Sales и Salesforce CRM. Пакетът включва и добавката Dynamics 365 за приложението Copilot.

Използвайте „Продажби“, за да се подготвяте за срещи с клиенти, да наваксвате с информацията за сделките, да изготвяте чернови на подходящи последващи съобщения и да получавате анализи и препоръки, генерирани от ИИ. „Продажби“ се свързва с Dynamics 365 Sales или Salesforce CRM, за да предоставя данни и възможности за продажби в тези среди.

Потребителите на Salesforce се нуждаят от лиценз за Microsoft 365 Copilot. Потребителите на Dynamics 365 Sales се нуждаят от отговарящ на условията лиценз за Dynamics 365. Необходима е настройка от администратор, а достъпът до конкретни среди зависи от лиценза, правомощията и достъпа на потребителя до съответния продукт на Microsoft.

**Настройка и обработка на данни**

„Продажби“ позволява на администраторите и потребителите да осъществяват достъп до съдържание и да споделят данни извън Microsoft 365, включително с услуги за управление на взаимоотношенията с клиенти (CRM) на трети страни. Такова споделяне на данни се регулира от общите условия на Microsoft и приложимите общи условия на CRM системите на трети страни. Споделянето на данни не се активира, докато администраторите и потребителите във вашата организация не дадат съгласие да свържат своя служебен или учебен акаунт в Microsoft с акаунта си в CRM.

„Продажби“ в Microsoft 365 Copilot ще има разрешение да участва в събрания в Microsoft Teams и да събира данни от събранията, като например записи и преписи.

Когато бъде разположено от администратор, „Продажби“ ще има разрешение автоматично да преглежда списъците с получатели на имейли и срещи при изпращане на имейли или при създаване или промяна на срещи. Това подпомага действия като предлагане на нови контакти за добавяне към CRM системата и показване на подходяща информация от CRM.

**Открийте още:**
- [Разгледайте какво е възможно с „Продажби“](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [ЧЗВ за „Продажби“](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Документация за Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/bg-bg/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Obteniu context i accions de vendes allà on ja treballeu, de manera que pugueu centrar-vos en els clients, fer seguiments més ràpidament i avançar en les promocions.

Sales porta l’agent de vendes al Microsoft 365 Copilot, l’Outlook i el Teams per als usuaris del Dynamics 365 Sales i el Salesforce CRM. El paquet també inclou el complement del Dynamics 365 Sales per al Copilot Cowork, el Copilot Code i el Microsoft Scout.

Utilitzeu Sales per preparar-vos per a reunions amb clients, posar-vos al dia sobre les promocions, redactar seguiments rellevants i obtenir conclusions i recomanacions generades per la IA. Sales es connecta al Dynamics 365 Sales o al Salesforce CRM per proporcionar dades i funcionalitats de vendes en aquestes experiències.

Els usuaris del Salesforce necessiten una llicència del Microsoft 365 Copilot. Els usuaris del Dynamics 365 Sales necessiten una llicència apta del Dynamics 365. Cal que l’administrador en faci la configuració i l’accés a experiències específiques depèn de la llicència, el dret i l’accés de l’usuari al producte de Microsoft corresponent.

**Configuració i gestió de dades**

El Dynamics 365 Sales permet als administradors i usuaris accedir al contingut i compartir dades fora de Microsoft 365, inclosos serveis de gestió de relacions de client (CRM) de tercers. Aquest intercanvi de dades està sotmès als termes i condicions del Microsoft i dels CRM de tercers aplicables. L'ús compartit de dades no s'habilita fins que els administradors i usuaris de la vostra organització donin el consentiment per connectar el seu compte professional o educatiu del Microsoft amb el seu compte del CRM.

El Dynamics 365 Sales del Microsoft 365 Copilot tindrà permís per participar en reunions del Microsoft Teams i recopilar dades de reunió del Teams, com ara enregistraments i transcripcions.

Quan un administrador l'implementi, Sales tindrà permís per revisar automàticament les llistes de destinataris de correus i cites en enviar correus o crear/modificar cites. Això permet accions com suggerir contactes nous per afegir-los al sistema CRM i mostrar informació rellevant del CRM.

**Descobriu-ne més:**
- [Exploreu el que és possible amb el Dynamics 365 Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Preguntes més freqüents del Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Documentació del Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

Zobrazte si kontext prodeje a akce tam, kde už pracujete, abyste se mohli soustředit na zákazníky, rychleji reagovat a posouvat obchody vpřed.

Sales přináší uživatelům Dynamics 365 Sales a Salesforce CRM agenta prodeje do služeb Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook a Teams. Balíček zahrnuje také modul plug-in Dynamics 365 pro aplikaci Copilot.

Používejte aplikaci Sales k přípravě na schůzky se zákazníky, získání přehledu o obchodech, vytváření konceptů relevantních reakcí a získávání přehledů a doporučení generovaných pomocí AI. Sales se připojuje k Dynamics 365 Sales nebo Salesforce CRM a v těchto prostředích poskytuje prodejní data a funkce.

Uživatelé Salesforce potřebují licenci na Microsoft 365 Copilota. Uživatelé Dynamics 365 Sales potřebují příslušnou licenci Dynamics 365. Je vyžadováno nastavení správcem a přístup ke konkrétním prostředím závisí na licenci uživatele, jeho nároku a přístupu k příslušnému produktu Microsoftu.

**Nastavení a zpracování dat**

Aplikace Sales umožňuje správcům a uživatelům přistupovat k obsahu a sdílet data mimo Microsoft 365, včetně služeb řízení vztahů se zákazníky (CRM) třetích stran. Takové sdílení dat podléhá podmínkám společnosti Microsoft a platným podmínkám řešení CRM třetích stran. Sdílení dat není povoleno, dokud správci a uživatelé ve vaší organizaci nedají souhlas s propojením svého pracovního nebo školního účtu Microsoft se svým účtem CRM.

Sales ve službě Microsoft 365 Copilot bude mít oprávnění účastnit se schůzek v Microsoft Teams a shromažďovat data ze schůzek v Teams, jako jsou záznamy a přepisy schůzek.

Když aplikaci Sales nasadí správce, bude mít oprávnění automaticky kontrolovat seznamy příjemců e-mailů a schůzek při odesílání e-mailů nebo při vytváření či úpravě schůzek. To podporuje akce, jako je navrhování nových kontaktů k přidání do systému CRM a zobrazování relevantních informací CRM.

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Få salgskontekst og adgang til handlinger dér, hvor du allerede arbejder – så du kan fokusere på kunderne, følge hurtigere op og føre salgsmuligheder videre.

Sales bringer Salgsagent til Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook og Teams for brugere af Dynamics 365 Sales og Salesforce CRM. Pakken indeholder også Dynamics 365-plug-in'en til Copilot-appen.

Brug Sales til at forberede kundemøder, holde dig ajour med salgsmuligheder, skrive relevante opfølgninger og få AI-genererede indsigter og anbefalinger. Sales opretter forbindelse til Dynamics 365 Sales eller Salesforce CRM for at levere salgsdata og funktioner i disse oplevelser.

Salesforce-brugere skal have en Microsoft 365 Copilot-licens. Brugere af Dynamics 365 Sales skal have en berettiget Dynamics 365-licens. Administratoropsætning er påkrævet, og adgangen til bestemte oplevelser afhænger af brugerens licens, berettigelse og adgang til det relevante Microsoft-produkt.

**Konfiguration og datahåndtering**

Sales giver administratorer og brugere mulighed for at få adgang til indhold og dele data uden for Microsoft 365, herunder med tredjeparts CRM-tjenester. Sådan datadeling er underlagt Microsofts og gældende tredjeparts CRM-vilkår og -betingelser. Datadeling aktiveres først, når administratorer og brugere i din organisation giver samtykke til at forbinde deres Microsoft arbejds- eller skolekonto med deres CRM-konto.

Sales i Microsoft 365 Copilot har tilladelse til at deltage i Microsoft Teams-møder og indsamle Teams-mødedata, f.eks. mødeoptagelser og transskriptioner.

Når Sales udrulles af en administrator, har den tilladelse til automatisk at gennemse modtagerlister for mails og aftaler, når der sendes mails eller oprettes eller ændres aftaler. Det understøtter handlinger som at foreslå nye kontakter, der kan føjes til CRM-systemet, og at vise relevante CRM-oplysninger.

Erhalten Sie Vertriebskontexte und Aktionen, in denen Sie bereits arbeiten, sodass Sie sich auf Kunden konzentrieren, schneller nacharbeiten und Deals nach vorne bringen können.

Sales bringt den Vertriebsmitarbeiter zu Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook und Teams für Benutzer von Dynamics 365 Sales und Salesforce CRM. Das Paket umfasst außerdem das Dynamics 365-Plug-In für die Copilot-App.

Verwenden Sie „Vertrieb“, um sich auf Kundenbesprechungen vorzubereiten, sich über Deals zu informieren, relevante Nachverfolgungen zu entwerfen und KI-generierte Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen zu erhalten. Der Vertrieb stellt eine Verbindung mit Dynamics 365 Sales oder Salesforce CRM her, um Vertriebsdaten und -funktionen in diesen Umgebungen bereitzustellen.

Salesforce-Benutzer benötigen eine Microsoft 365 Copilot-Lizenz. Dynamics 365 Sales-Benutzer benötigen eine berechtigte Dynamics 365-Lizenzierung. Das Adminsetup ist erforderlich, und der Zugriff auf bestimmte Erfahrungen hängt von der Lizenzierung, Berechtigung und dem Zugriff des Benutzers auf das relevante Microsoft-Produkt ab.

**Einrichtung und Datenverarbeitung**

Sales ermöglicht Admins und Benutzern den Zugriff auf Inhalte und die Freigabe von Daten außerhalb von Microsoft 365, auch mit CRM-Diensten von Drittanbietern. Diese Datenfreigabe unterliegt den CRM-Bedingungen von Microsoft und der jeweiligen Drittanbieter. Die Datenfreigabe wird erst aktiviert, wenn Admins und Benutzer in Ihrer Organisation zustimmen, ihr Geschäfts-, Schul- oder Unikonto von Microsoft mit ihrem CRM-Konto zu verbinden.

Der Vertrieb in Microsoft 365 Copilot hat die Berechtigung, an Microsoft Teams-Besprechungen teilzunehmen und Teams-Besprechungsdaten wie Besprechungsaufzeichnungen und Transkripte zu sammeln.

Bei der Bereitstellung durch einen Admin ist Sales berechtigt, E-Mail- und Terminempfängerlisten automatisch zu überprüfen, wenn E-Mails gesendet oder Termine erstellt oder geändert werden. Dies unterstützt Aktionen wie das Vorschlagen neuer Kontakte zum Hinzufügen zum CRM-System und das Anzeigen relevanter CRM-Informationen.

– [Häufig gestellte Fragen zum Vertrieb](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)

agentSkills.description: Required for general-purpose customer Pitch Decks: cold first meetings, warm-lead product introductions, industry pitches, and internal enablement. localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Αποκτήστε το περιβάλλον και τις ενέργειες πωλήσεων εκεί όπου εργάζεστε ήδη—ώστε να μπορείτε να επικεντρώνεστε στους πελάτες, να κάνετε ταχύτερα την παρακολούθηση και να προωθείτε τις συμφωνίες.

Η υπηρεσία Πωλήσεις φέρνει τον Παράγοντα πωλήσεων στο Microsoft 365 Copilot, το Outlook και το Teams για τους χρήστες του Dynamics 365 Sales και του Salesforce CRM. Το πακέτο περιλαμβάνει επίσης το πρόσθετο Dynamics 365 Sales για τα Copilot Cowork, Copilot Code και Microsoft Scout.

Χρησιμοποιήστε την υπηρεσία Πωλήσεις για να προετοιμαστείτε για συσκέψεις με πελάτες, να ενημερωθείτε για την πορεία των συμφωνιών, να συντάξετε σχετικές επικοινωνίες παρακολούθησης και να λάβετε πληροφορίες και προτάσεις που δημιουργούνται από το ΑΙ. Η υπηρεσία Πωλήσεις συνδέεται με το Dynamics 365 Sales ή το Salesforce CRM, για να παρέχει δεδομένα πωλήσεων και δυνατότητες σε αυτές τις εμπειρίες.

Οι χρήστες του Salesforce απαιτούν άδεια χρήσης Microsoft 365 Copilot. Οι χρήστες του Dynamics 365 Sales απαιτούν κατάλληλη χορήγηση άδειας χρήσης του Dynamics 365. Απαιτείται διαμόρφωση από τον διαχειριστή, ενώ η πρόσβαση σε συγκεκριμένες εμπειρίες εξαρτάται από την χορήγηση άδειας χρήσης του χρήστη, το δικαίωμα χρήσης και την πρόσβαση στο σχετικό προϊόν της Microsoft.

**Διαμόρφωση και χειρισμός δεδομένων**

Η υπηρεσία Πωλήσεις επιτρέπει σε διαχειριστές και χρήστες να έχουν πρόσβαση σε περιεχόμενο και να κάνουν κοινή χρήση δεδομένων εκτός του Microsoft 365, συμπεριλαμβανομένων υπηρεσιών διαχείρισης σχέσεων πελατών (CRM) τρίτων. Η εν λόγω κοινή χρήση δεδομένων υπόκειται στους όρους και τις προϋποθέσεις της Microsoft και των εκάστοτε υπηρεσιών CRM τρίτων κατασκευαστών. Η κοινή χρήση δεδομένων δεν ενεργοποιείται έως ότου οι διαχειριστές και οι χρήστες στον οργανισμό σας συναινέσουν να συνδέσουν τον εταιρικό ή σχολικό λογαριασμό Microsoft τους με τον λογαριασμό CRM.

Η λύση Πωλήσεις στο Microsoft 365 Copilot θα έχει δικαίωμα συμμετοχής σε συσκέψεις του Microsoft Teams και συλλογής δεδομένων συσκέψεων του Teams, όπως εγγραφών συσκέψεων και απομαγνητοφωνήσεων.

Όταν η εφαρμογή Πωλήσεις αναπτύσσεται από έναν διαχειριστή, θα έχει δικαίωμα αυτόματου ελέγχου των λιστών παραληπτών ηλεκτρονικού ταχυδρομείου και των παραληπτών συναντήσεων κατά την αποστολή μηνυμάτων ηλεκτρονικού ταχυδρομείου ή τη δημιουργία ή τροποποίηση συναντήσεων. Αυτό υποστηρίζει ενέργειες όπως η πρόταση νέων επαφών για προσθήκη στο σύστημα CRM και η εμφάνιση σχετικών πληροφοριών CRM.

**Ανακαλύψτε περισσότερα:**
- [Εξερευνήστε τι είναι δυνατό με τις Πωλήσεις](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Συνήθεις ερωτήσεις για τις Πωλήσεις](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Τεκμηρίωση του Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Obtenga contexto y acciones de ventas en su entorno de trabajo habitual para centrarse en los clientes, hacer seguimientos con mayor rapidez y avanzar en las oportunidades.

Ventas incorpora el agente de Ventas a Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook y Teams para los usuarios de Dynamics 365 Sales y Salesforce CRM. El paquete también incluye el complemento de Dynamics 365 para la aplicación Copilot.

Use Ventas para prepararse para reuniones con clientes, ponerse al día sobre las oportunidades, redactar mensajes de seguimiento pertinentes y obtener información y recomendaciones generadas por IA. Ventas se conecta a Dynamics 365 Sales o Salesforce CRM para proporcionar datos y funcionalidades de ventas en estas experiencias.

Los usuarios de Salesforce necesitan una licencia de Microsoft 365 Copilot. Los usuarios de Dynamics 365 Sales necesitan una licencia de Dynamics 365 que cumpla los requisitos. Se requiere configuración por parte del administrador, y el acceso a experiencias específicas depende de las licencias del usuario, sus derechos de licencia y su acceso al producto de Microsoft correspondiente.

**Configuración y tratamiento de datos**

Ventas permite a los administradores y usuarios acceder a contenido y compartir datos fuera de Microsoft 365, incluso con servicios de administración de relaciones con los clientes (CRM) de terceros. Este uso compartido de datos está sujeto a los términos y condiciones de Microsoft y de los proveedores de CRM externos correspondientes. El uso compartido de datos no está habilitado hasta que los administradores y usuarios de su organización den su consentimiento para conectar su cuenta profesional o educativa de Microsoft con su cuenta de CRM.

Ventas en Microsoft 365 Copilot tendrá permiso para participar en reuniones de Microsoft Teams y recopilar datos de reuniones de Teams, como grabaciones y transcripciones.

Cuando un administrador lo implemente, Ventas tendrá permiso para revisar automáticamente las listas de destinatarios de correos electrónicos y citas al enviar correos electrónicos o crear o modificar citas. Esto permite acciones como sugerir nuevos contactos para añadirlos al sistema CRM y mostrar información de CRM pertinente.

**Más información:**
- [Explore las posibilidades de Ventas](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Preguntas frecuentes sobre Ventas](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Documentación de Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Hankige müügikontekst ja -toimingud seal, kus te juba töötate – et saaksite hoida fookust klientidel, teha kiiremini järeltegevusi ja viia tehinguid edasi.

Sales toob rakenduste Dynamics 365 Sales ja Salesforce CRM kasutajate jaoks Salesi agendi keskkondadesse Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook ja Teams. Pakett sisaldab ka rakenduse Copilot lisandmoodulit Dynamics 365.

Kasutage lahendust Sales, et valmistuda kliendikohtumisteks, viia end kurssi tehingutega, koostada asjakohaseid järeltegevusi ning hankida tehisintellekti genereeritud ülevaateid ja soovitusi. Sales loob ühenduse teenusega Dynamics 365 Sales või Salesforce CRM, et pakkuda nendes keskkondades müügiandmeid ja -võimeid.

Salesforce’i kasutajad vajavad Microsoft 365 Copiloti litsentsi. Dynamics 365 Salesi kasutajad vajavad sobilikku Dynamics 365 litsentsi. Nõutav on administraatoripoolne häälestus ja juurdepääs konkreetsetele keskkondadele sõltub kasutaja litsentsist, õigusest ning juurdepääsust asjakohasele Microsofti tootele.

**Häälestus ja andmetöötlus**

Sales võimaldab administraatoritel ja kasutajatel pääseda sisule juurde ning jagada andmeid väljaspool Microsoft 365, sealhulgas kolmanda osapoole kliendisuhete halduse (CRM) teenustega. Sellisele andmete jagamisele kehtivad Microsofti ja kohaldatavad kolmanda osapoole CRM-i tingimused. Andmete jagamine pole lubatud enne, kui teie organisatsiooni administraatorid ja kasutajad annavad nõusoleku oma Microsofti töö- või koolikonto ühendamiseks oma CRM-i kontoga.

Lahendusel Sales teenuses Microsoft 365 Copilot on luba osaleda Microsoft Teamsi koosolekutel ja koguda Teamsi koosolekuandmeid, näiteks koosolekute salvestisi ja transkriptsioone.

Kui administraator on selle juurutanud, on lahendusel Sales luba meilide saatmisel või kohtumiste loomisel või muutmisel automaatselt läbi vaadata meilide ja kohtumiste adressaatide loendid. See toetab selliseid toiminguid nagu uute kontaktide soovitamine CRM-süsteemi lisamiseks ja asjakohase CRM-teabe kuvamine.

**Lisateave:**
- [Uurige, mida kõike saab Salesiga teha](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Salesi KKK](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 dokumentatsioon](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Lan egiten duzun tokian bertan, eskuratu salmenten testuingurua eta egin beharreko ekintzak. Horrela, bezeroengan zentratu, jarraipenak azkarrago egin eta akordioak aurrera eraman ditzakezu.

Salmentak Salmenta-agentea Microsoft 365 Copilot-era, Outlook-era eta Teams-era eramaten du, Dynamics 365 Sales eta Salesforce CRM erabiltzaileentzat. Paketeak Copilot aplikaziorako Dynamics 365 plugina ere badakar.

Erabili Salmentak bezero-bilerak prestatzeko, akordioen egoeraren berri izateko, dagozkion jarraipen-mezuen zirriborroak egiteko eta AAk sortutako xehetasunak eta gomendioak jasotzeko. Salmentak Dynamics 365 Sales-era edo Salesforce CRM-era konektatzen da, esperientzia horietan salmenta-datuak eta -gaitasunak eskaintzeko.

Salesforce-ko erabiltzaileek Microsoft 365 Copilot-en lizentzia behar dute. Dynamics 365 Sales-eko erabiltzaileek Dynamics 365-en lizentzia egokia behar dute. Administratzaileak konfiguratu behar du, eta esperientzia jakinetarako sarbidea erabiltzailearen lizentziaren, eskubidearen eta dagokion Microsoft produktuaren sarbidearen araberakoa da.

**Konfigurazioa eta datuen kudeaketa**

Salmentek administratzaileei eta erabiltzaileei aukera ematen die Microsoft 365-etik kanpoko edukietara sartzeko eta datuak partekatzeko, baita hirugarrenen bezero-erlazio kudeaketa (CRM) zerbitzuekin ere. Datu-partekatze hori Microsoft-en eta aplikagarri diren hirugarrenen CRM baldintza eta zehaztapenetara lotuta dago. Datu-partekatzea ez dago gaituta zure erakundeko administratzaile eta erabiltzaileek beren Microsoft laneko edo eskolako kontua beren CRM kontura konektatzea onartzen duten arte.

Microsoft 365 Copilot-eko Sales aplikazioak baimena izango du Microsoft Teams bileretako parte-hartzaile izateko eta Teams bilerako datuak biltzeko, hala nola bileren grabazioak eta transkripzioak.

Administratzaile batek Salmentak inplementatzen duenean, baimena izango du mezu elektronikoak bidaltzean edo hitzorduak sortzean edo aldatzean mezu elektronikoen eta hitzorduen hartzaileen zerrendak automatikoki berrikusteko. Horri esker, besteak beste, CRM sisteman gehitzeko kontaktu berriak iradoki eta CRMko informazio garrantzitsua bistaratu ahal izango du.

**Aurkitu eduki gehiago:**
- [Ezagutu Sales-ek eskaintzen dituen aukera guztiak](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Salmentak-eko maiz egiten diren galderak](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 documentazioa](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Hanki myyntikonteksti ja toiminnot, joissa jo työskentelet—, jotta voit keskittyä asiakkaisiin, seurata nopeammin ja siirtää sopimuksia eteenpäin.

Sales tuo Sales-agentin Microsoft 365 Copilotiin, Outlookiin ja Teamsiin Dynamics 365 Salesin ja Salesforce CRM:n käyttäjille. Paketti sisältää myös Copilot-sovelluksen Dynamics 365 -laajennuksen.

Sales auttaa valmistautumaan asiakastapaamisiin, perehtymään kauppojen tilanteeseen, laatimaan asiaankuuluvia seurantaviestejä sekä saamaan tekoälyn tuottamia merkityksellisiä tietoja ja suosituksia. Sales muodostaa yhteyden Dynamics 365 Salesiin tai Salesforce CRM:ään ja tuo näihin käyttökokemuksiin myyntitiedot ja -ominaisuudet.

Salesforce-käyttäjät tarvitsevat Microsoft 365 Copilot -käyttöoikeuden. Dynamics 365 Sales -käyttäjät tarvitsevat soveltuvan Dynamics 365 -käyttöoikeuden. Järjestelmänvalvojan on tehtävä määritykset, ja pääsy tiettyihin käyttökokemuksiin riippuu käyttäjän käyttöoikeuksista, oikeuksista ja pääsystä tarvittavaan Microsoft-tuotteeseen.

**Määritykset ja tietojen käsittely**

Myynti antaa järjestelmänvalvojille ja käyttäjille mahdollisuuden käyttää sisältöä ja jakaa tietoja Microsoft 365:n ulkopuolella, myös kolmansien osapuolten asiakkuudenhallintapalveluiden (CRM) kanssa. Tällainen tiedonjakaminen noudattaa Microsoftin ja soveltuvien kolmansien osapuolten CRM-järjestelmien ehtoja. Tietojen jakaminen ei ole käytössä, ennen kuin organisaation järjestelmänvalvojat ja käyttäjät hyväksyvät Microsoftin työ- tai koulutilin yhdistämisen CRM-tiliin.

Microsoft 365 Copilotin myynnillä on oikeus osallistua Microsoft Teams -kokouksiin ja kerätä Teams-kokoustietoja, kuten kokoustallenteita ja tallenteita.

Kun järjestelmänvalvoja on ottanut sen käyttöön, myynti saa oikeuden tarkistaa sähköpostin ja tapaamisen vastaanottajaluettelot automaattisesti, kun sähköpostia lähetetään tai tapaamisia luodaan tai muokataan. Tämä mahdollistaa esimerkiksi uusien yhteystietojen ehdottamisen CRM-järjestelmään lisättäväksi ja asiaankuuluvien CRM-tietojen näyttämisen.

- [Salesin usein kysytyt kysymykset](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 -dokumentaatio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Obtenez le contexte et les actions de vente là où vous travaillez déjà, pour pouvoir vous concentrer sur vos clients, assurer un suivi plus rapide et faire progresser vos opportunités commerciales.

Sales intègre l’agent Sales à Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook et Teams pour les utilisateurs de Dynamics 365 Sales et de Salesforce CRM. Le package inclut également le plug-in Dynamics 365 pour l’application Copilot.

Utilisez Sales pour vous préparer aux réunions avec vos clients, vous tenir au courant de vos opportunités commerciales, rédiger des messages de suivi pertinents et obtenir des aperçus et des recommandations générés par l’IA. Sales se connecte à Dynamics 365 Sales ou à Salesforce CRM pour fournir des données et des capacités de vente dans ces expériences.

Les utilisateurs de Salesforce doivent disposer d’une licence Microsoft 365 Copilot. Les utilisateurs de Dynamics 365 Sales doivent disposer d’une licence Dynamics 365 éligible. La configuration par un administrateur est requise. L’accès à certaines expériences dépend de la licence de l’utilisateur, de ses droits et de son accès au produit Microsoft concerné.

**Configuration et gestion des données**

Sales permet aux administrateurs et aux utilisateurs d’accéder au contenu et de partager des données en dehors de Microsoft 365, y compris avec des services tiers de gestion de la relation client (CRM). Ce partage de données est soumis aux conditions générales de Microsoft et des processus de CRM tiers applicables. Le partage des données n’est pas activé tant que les administrateurs et les utilisateurs de votre organisation n’ont pas consenti à connecter leurs comptes professionnels ou scolaires Microsoft à leurs comptes CRM.

Sales dans Microsoft 365 Copilot aura l’autorisation de participer aux réunions Microsoft Teams et de collecter des données les concernant, telles que des enregistrements et des transcriptions des réunions.

Lorsqu’un administrateur déploie Sales, celui-ci est autorisé à examiner automatiquement les listes de destinataires des e-mails et des rendez-vous lors de l’envoi d’e-mails ou de la création ou de la modification de rendez-vous. Cela permet notamment de suggérer de nouveaux contacts à ajouter au système CRM et d’afficher les informations CRM pertinentes.

**Découvrir plus :**
- [Découvrez les possibilités offertes par Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [FAQ sur les ventes](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Documentation Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)
localizedDefinitions.shortDescription: La solution Sales dans Microsoft 365 Copilot réinvente le travail des vendeurs

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Obtén contexto e accións de vendas onde xa traballas, para que poidas centrarte nos clientes, facer un seguimento máis rápido e facer avanzar os acordos.

Sales leva o axente de vendas a Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook e Teams para usuarios de Dynamics 365 Sales e Salesforce CRM. O paquete tamén inclúe o complemento de Dynamics 365 para a aplicación Copilot.

Usa Vendas para preparar reunións con clientes, poñerte ao día con acordos, redactar seguimentos relevantes e obter información e recomendacións xeradas por IA. Sales conéctase a Dynamics 365 Sales ou Salesforce CRM para proporcionar datos e funcionalidades de vendas nestas experiencias.

Os usuarios de Salesforce requiren unha Licenza de Microsoft 365 Copilot. Os usuarios de Dynamics 365 Sales requiren licenzas de Dynamics 365 elixibles. É necesaria a configuración do administrador e o acceso a experiencias específicas depende das licenzas, os dereitos e o acceso do usuario ao produto de Microsoft correspondente.

**Configuración e xestión de datos**

As vendas permiten aos administradores e usuarios acceder a contido e compartir datos fóra de Microsoft 365, incluíndo servizos de xestión de relacións cos clientes (CRM) de terceiros. Este uso compartido de datos está suxeito aos termos e condicións de CRM de Microsoft e de terceiros aplicables. O uso compartido de datos non está activado ata que os administradores e os usuarios da súa organización dean o seu consentimento para conectar as súas contas de traballo ou escolar de Microsoft coa súa conta de CRM.

O equipo de vendas de Microsoft 365 Copilot terá permiso para participar en reunións de Microsoft Teams e recompilar datos de reunións de Teams, como gravacións e transcricións de reunións.

agentSkills.name: d365-sales-activity-synthesis

agentSkills.description: Use to draft a decision-ready business case for one deal or initiative — the customer's baseline problem, the supported impact and cost of inaction, the proposed change and its contribution, and an investment and value case, tailored to a named audience. Produces a reviewable draft; saving or sending requires a separate, explicitly approved action. Not for a price or discount quote, and not for a generic capability pitch.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-business-case-composer

agentSkills.description: Use when a named or suspected competitor must be positioned against customer requirements, decision criteria, or objections for a specific opportunity. Not for generic market research or unsupported competitor claims.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-competitive-strategy

agentSkills.description: Use when a bounded set of sales records needs an evidence-based review for absent, malformed, stale, inconsistent, or unverified data and a proposed correction report. Also applies to an export or supplied table; not for deep reconciliation of one opportunity or team-performance review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-crm-data-hygiene

agentSkills.description: Use when an account needs a phased engagement plan across stakeholders, coverage gaps, relationship paths, and business objectives. Use a 30-day horizon when requested; not for choosing only the immediate next buyer.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-customer-engagement-strategy

agentSkills.description: Use to report what changed and why across a scoped set of deals since a stated baseline — which deals slipped, or what moved on a bounded top set since a point in time. Needs a defined scope and current deal evidence; a baseline improves the comparison, but a current-state result is available without one. Not for ranking what to work on next or a single deal's full standing review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-catchup

agentSkills.description: Use when a deal's product/price configuration needs to be built, judged for fit, or corrected, turned into a quote, and/or advanced to the next business-process stage — including reasoning about whether a proposed configuration is net-new, an expansion, or a renewal, and what it will actually cost.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-desk

agentSkills.description: Use when a seller or manager needs to test an alleged slowdown on one specific opportunity and decide whether it is a supported stall, a record-hygiene issue, or not currently supported by the evidence, then recommend recovery, restructuring, escalation, or disqualification. Not for a change digest across many deals, a leadership status review, cross-set ranking, or an ordinary healthy-deal lookup.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-rescue

agentSkills.description: Use to draft outreach for people the seller met whose pending asks need follow-up, or previously responsive open leads that have gone quiet. Ground drafts in substantive evidence and assess the contact policy for the actual purpose and channel. Produces reviewable text; saving or sending requires a separate, explicitly approved action. Not for a completed meeting's summary and action capture, choosing the next stakeholder, or cold prospecting.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-draft-outreach

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity needs a leadership-ready review of current state, material movement over a defined period, risks, decisions, and a specific leadership ask. Not for a team-wide pipeline review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-executive-deal-review

agentSkills.description: Use when one lead needs an evidence-backed assessment against an explicitly supplied qualification method, including criterion-level gaps, a disposition recommendation, and proposed routing. Not for inventing BANT, forcing a binary decision, or configuring an existing opportunity.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-lead-disposition

agentSkills.description: Use before one customer meeting or sales interaction to prepare an evidence-backed objective, participant brief, relevant context, open commitments, agenda, questions, talking points, risks, and desired outcomes. Works from supplied material; not for post-meeting capture, a phased account plan, or a seller's coaching agenda.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-meeting-prep

agentSkills.description: Use to produce a ranked worklist of which opportunities in a scoped set to work next and why now, weighing value, urgency, risk, momentum, and influenceability. Needs a defined opportunity scope and current opportunity evidence; a live engagement history improves the read but is not required. Not for reporting what changed on a set of deals, a single meeting brief, or a full team pipeline review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-pipeline-prioritizer

agentSkills.description: Use after one sales meeting or call to separate facts, decisions, commitments, and open topics; propose durable record updates and next actions; and draft follow-up communication when requested. Not for a broad account history or work-period capture.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-post-meeting-follow-up

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity's recorded representation needs to be compared with dated business evidence to identify drift, stale or incomplete values, contradictions, and unsupported claims. Works without current record access as a bounded observations report; not for a wide hygiene sweep.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-reconcile-my-opportunity

agentSkills.description: Use when an opportunity must be evaluated against explicit organizational requirements for a defined next stage, with each criterion marked met, unmet, unknown, or conflicting. Not for inferring readiness from a stage label or activity volume.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-stage-advance-readiness

agentSkills.description: turn sales, customer, usage, value, pipeline, and financial data from crm systems, excel workbooks, and other connected sources into one or more executive-ready powerpoint slides. use to visualize data, create charts or scorecards, add data-driven insights to a deck, update existing slides with current metrics, compare customers or periods, explain business performance, or build an executive sales narrative from quantitative data.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-visualize-sales-data

agentSkills.description: Use this skill first for creating a source-grounded internal account brief for a named customer or prospect - what matters to the customer, who matters in the decision, where we stand, which opportunities to validate, and what to do next. Saves an editable PowerPoint deck. Use for requests such as "create an account brief for Northstar", "build a briefing deck on this customer for our sales team", "make an account briefing deck from these notes and filings", or "prepare a prospect brief". Do NOT use for creating login or user accounts, preparing for one upcoming meeting or call unless a deck is asked for, customer-facing sales pitches, QBRs or adoption reviews, annual account plans with quotas or pipeline forecasts, summarizing or fact-checking an existing deck, drawing a reporting hierarchy alone, briefs wanted as a Word, PDF, or Markdown file, or research answered in chat with no brief file requested. For matching tasks, load this skill before any generic PowerPoint/presentation skill.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-account-brief

agentSkills.description: Create a buyer-specific proposal or bid presentation responding to explicit requirements or an RFP, with coverage, evidence, delivery, commercials and limits. Use for "respond to the buyer's requirements" or "prepare our RFP proposal deck". Do NOT use for a proactive customer product or solution pitch, investor pitches, customer business reviews, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-proposal-response

agentSkills.description: Required for general-purpose customer Pitch Decks: cold first meetings, warm-lead product introductions, industry pitches, and internal enablement. Use for "pitch our product to a new buyer" or "introduce our solution". Do NOT use for formal RFPs or buyer-requirement proposals, investor/fundraising pitches, QBRs, account plans, pipeline reports, or edits.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-sales-pitch

agentSkills.description: Use when the user explicitly requests a sales results or forecast summary deck for senior leadership, highlighting expected outcomes, material risks and decisions requiring executive support. Use for "build a sales results deck for our leaders" or "create forecast summary slides for the VP". Do NOT use for forecast or pipeline analysis answered in the conversation, one opportunity's leadership review unless a deck is asked for, deal-by-deal pipeline management, customer-facing business reviews, proactive pitches, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-executive-sales-summary

agentSkills.description: Prepare a seller to handle a specific customer''s likely objections. For each objection: the customer''s wording, discovery questions to ask live, a short evidence-backed response, the proof behind it or the evidence still missing, and a confirming next step. Delivered by default as a separate internal deck, or as removable slides appended to the current deck or kept in chat when the user asks. Use when the user asks to "prep me for this customer''s objections", "how do I answer their pushback on price", "build objection handling for this deal", "what will the buyer push back on and how should I respond", "objection responses for the concerns they raised on the call", or "talk tracks for handling procurement''s objections". Do NOT use to stress-test, score or find weaknesses in a presentation''s own argument, to play devil''s advocate, for general Q&A rehearsal, to write speaker notes or a talk track for the deck itself, or to build or redesign a pitch.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-prepare-objection-responses

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
קבל הקשר ופעולות בתחום המכירות במקום שבו אתה כבר עובד – כדי שתוכל להתמקד בלקוחות, לבצע מעקב מהר יותר ולקדם עסקאות.

‏Sales מביא את סוכן Sales ל- Microsoft 365 Copilot, ל- Outlook ול- Teams לשימושם של משתמשי Dynamics 365 Sales ו- Salesforce CRM. החבילה כוללת גם את תוסף Dynamics 365 לאפליקציית Copilot.

השתמש ב- Sales כדי להתכונן לפגישות עם לקוחות, להתעדכן בעסקאות, לנסח הודעות מעקב רלוונטיות ולקבל תובנות והמלצות שנוצרו באמצעות בינה מלאכותית. Sales מתחבר ל- Dynamics 365 Sales או ל- Salesforce CRM כדי לספק נתונים ויכולות בתחום המכירות בחוויות אלה.

משתמשי Salesforce זקוקים לרישיון Microsoft 365 Copilot. משתמשי Dynamics 365 Sales זקוקים לרישוי מתאים של Dynamics 365. נדרשת הגדרה על-ידי מנהל מערכת, והגישה לחוויות ספציפיות תלויה ברישוי, בזכאות ובגישה של המשתמש למוצר Microsoft הרלוונטי.

**הגדרה וטיפול בנתונים**

Sales מאפשר למנהלי מערכת ולמשתמשים לגשת לתוכן ולשתף נתונים מחוץ ל- Microsoft 365, כולל עם שירותי ניהול קשרי לקוחות (CRM) של צד שלישי. שיתוף נתונים כזה כפוף לתנאים ולהגבלות של Microsoft ושל שירותי ה- CRM הרלוונטיים של צד שלישי. שיתוף הנתונים אינו זמין עד שמנהלי מערכת ומשתמשים בארגון שלך מסכימים לחבר את חשבון העבודה או הלימודים שלהם ב- Microsoft לחשבון ה- CRM שלהם.

ל- Sales ב- Microsoft 365 Copilot תהיה הרשאה להשתתף בפגישות Microsoft Teams ולאסוף נתוני פגישות Teams, כגון הקלטות ותמלילים של פגישות.

כאשר Sales נפרס על-ידי מנהל מערכת, תהיה לו הרשאה לבדוק אוטומטית רשימות נמענים של הודעות דואר אלקטרוני ופגישות בעת שליחת הודעות דואר אלקטרוני או יצירה או שינוי של פגישות. הדבר תומך בפעולות כגון הצעת אנשי קשר חדשים להוספה למערכת ה- CRM והצגת מידע רלוונטי ממערכת ה- CRM.

**גלה עוד:**
- [גלה מה אפשר לעשות עם Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [שאלות נפוצות על Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [תיעוד Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
जहाँ आप पहले से काम करते हैं, वहीं Sales संदर्भ और क्रियाएँ प्राप्त करें—ताकि आप ग्राहकों पर ध्यान केंद्रित कर सकें, तेज़ी से फ़ॉलो-अप कर सकें और डील्स को आगे बढ़ा सकें.

Sales, Dynamics 365 Sales और Salesforce CRM के उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook और Teams में विक्रय एजेंट उपलब्ध कराता है. इस पैकेज में Copilot Cowork, Copilot Code और Microsoft Scout के लिए Dynamics 365 Sales प्लगइन भी शामिल है.

ग्राहक से मीटिंग की तैयारी करने, डील्स की जानकारी से अपडेट रहने, प्रासंगिक फ़ॉलो-अप का ड्राफ़्ट तैयार करने और AI द्वारा जनरेट की गई इनसाइट्स और सुझाव प्राप्त करने के लिए ‘Sales’ का उपयोग करें. इन अनुभवों में विक्रय डेटा और क्षमताएँ उपलब्ध कराने के लिए Sales, Dynamics 365 Sales या Salesforce CRM से कनेक्ट होता है.

Salesforce उपयोगकर्ताओं के पास Microsoft 365 Copilot लाइसेंस होना आवश्यक है. Dynamics 365 Sales उपयोगकर्ताओं के पास योग्य Dynamics 365 लाइसेंसिंग होना आवश्यक है. व्यवस्थापक सेटअप आवश्यक है और विशिष्ट अनुभवों तक पहुँच उपयोगकर्ता के लाइसेंस, पात्रता और संबंधित Microsoft उत्पाद तक पहुँच पर निर्भर करती है.

**सेटअप और डेटा हैंडलिंग**

Sales, व्यवस्थापकों और उपयोगकर्ताओं को Microsoft 365 के बाहर सामग्री तक पहुँचने और डेटा साझा करने की सुविधा देता है, जिसमें तृतीय-पक्ष ग्राहक संबंध प्रबंधन (CRM) सेवाएँ भी शामिल हैं. इस तरह के डेटा साझाकरण Microsoft और लागू तृतीय-पक्ष CRM के नियम और शर्तों के अधीन हैं. डेटा साझाकरण तब तक सक्षम नहीं होता जब तक आपके संगठन के व्यवस्थापक और उपयोगकर्ता अपने Microsoft कार्यस्थल या विद्यालय खाते को अपने CRM खाते से कनेक्ट करने की सहमति नहीं देते.

Microsoft 365 Copilot में Sales को Microsoft Teams मीटिंग में भाग लेने और मीटिंग रिकॉर्डिंग और ट्रांसक्रिप्ट जैसे Teams मीटिंग डेटा एकत्र करने की अनुमति होगी.

व्यवस्थापक द्वारा परिनियोजित किए जाने पर, Sales को ईमेल भेजते समय या अपॉइंटमेंट बनाते या संशोधित करते समय ईमेल और अपॉइंटमेंट प्राप्तकर्ता सूचियों की स्वचालित रूप से समीक्षा करने की अनुमति होगी. इससे CRM सिस्टम में जोड़ने के लिए नए संपर्कों का सुझाव देने और प्रासंगिक CRM जानकारी प्रदर्शित करने जैसी क्रियाओं में सहायता मिलती है.

agentSkills.description: Use when a named or suspected competitor must be positioned against customer requirements, decision criteria, or objections for a specific opportunity. Not for generic market research or unsupported competitor claims.

agentSkills.description: Use when a bounded set of sales records needs an evidence-based review for absent, malformed, stale, inconsistent, or unverified data and a proposed correction report. agentSkills.description: Use to draft outreach for people the seller met whose pending asks need follow-up, or previously responsive open leads that have gone quiet. agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity needs a leadership-ready review of current state, material movement over a defined period, risks, decisions, and a specific leadership ask. Not for a team-wide pipeline review.

agentSkills.description: Use when one lead needs an evidence-backed assessment against an explicitly supplied qualification method, including criterion-level gaps, a disposition recommendation, and proposed routing. agentSkills.description: Use before one customer meeting or sales interaction to prepare an evidence-backed objective, participant brief, relevant context, open commitments, agenda, questions, talking points, risks, and desired outcomes. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-meeting-prep

agentSkills.description: Use to produce a ranked worklist of which opportunities in a scoped set to work next and why now, weighing value, urgency, risk, momentum, and influenceability. Needs a defined opportunity scope and current opportunity evidence; a live engagement history improves the read but is not required. Not for reporting what changed on a set of deals, a single meeting brief, or a full team pipeline review.

agentSkills.description: Use after one sales meeting or call to separate facts, decisions, commitments, and open topics; propose durable record updates and next actions; and draft follow-up communication when requested. Not for a broad account history or work-period capture.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-post-meeting-follow-up

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity's recorded representation needs to be compared with dated business evidence to identify drift, stale or incomplete values, contradictions, and unsupported claims. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-reconcile-my-opportunity

agentSkills.description: Use when an opportunity must be evaluated against explicit organizational requirements for a defined next stage, with each criterion marked met, unmet, unknown, or conflicting. Not for inferring readiness from a stage label or activity volume.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-stage-advance-readiness

agentSkills.description: turn sales, customer, usage, value, pipeline, and financial data from crm systems, excel workbooks, and other connected sources into one or more executive-ready powerpoint slides. use to visualize data, create charts or scorecards, add data-driven insights to a deck, update existing slides with current metrics, compare customers or periods, explain business performance, or build an executive sales narrative from quantitative data.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-visualize-sales-data

agentSkills.description: Use this skill first for creating a source-grounded internal account brief for a named customer or prospect - what matters to the customer, who matters in the decision, where we stand, which opportunities to validate, and what to do next. Saves an editable PowerPoint deck. Use for requests such as "create an account brief for Northstar", "build a briefing deck on this customer for our sales team", "make an account briefing deck from these notes and filings", or "prepare a prospect brief". Do NOT use for creating login or user accounts, preparing for one upcoming meeting or call unless a deck is asked for, customer-facing sales pitches, QBRs or adoption reviews, annual account plans with quotas or pipeline forecasts, summarizing or fact-checking an existing deck, drawing a reporting hierarchy alone, briefs wanted as a Word, PDF, or Markdown file, or research answered in chat with no brief file requested. agentSkills.description: Create a buyer-specific proposal or bid presentation responding to explicit requirements or an RFP, with coverage, evidence, delivery, commercials and limits. Do NOT use for a proactive customer product or solution pitch, investor pitches, customer business reviews, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-proposal-response

agentSkills.description: Required for general-purpose customer Pitch Decks: cold first meetings, warm-lead product introductions, industry pitches, and internal enablement. Use for "pitch our product to a new buyer" or "introduce our solution". Do NOT use for formal RFPs or buyer-requirement proposals, investor/fundraising pitches, QBRs, account plans, pipeline reports, or edits.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-sales-pitch

agentSkills.description: Use when the user explicitly requests a sales results or forecast summary deck for senior leadership, highlighting expected outcomes, material risks and decisions requiring executive support. Use for "build a sales results deck for our leaders" or "create forecast summary slides for the VP". Do NOT use for forecast or pipeline analysis answered in the conversation, one opportunity's leadership review unless a deck is asked for, deal-by-deal pipeline management, customer-facing business reviews, proactive pitches, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-executive-sales-summary

agentSkills.description: Prepare a seller to handle a specific customer''s likely objections. For each objection: the customer''s wording, discovery questions to ask live, a short evidence-backed response, the proof behind it or the evidence still missing, and a confirming next step. Delivered by default as a separate internal deck, or as removable slides appended to the current deck or kept in chat when the user asks. Do NOT use to stress-test, score or find weaknesses in a presentation''s own argument, to play devil''s advocate, for general Q&A rehearsal, to write speaker notes or a talk track for the deck itself, or to build or redesign a pitch.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-prepare-objection-responses

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Dohvatite kontekst prodaje i radnje na mjestu na kojem već radite – kako biste se mogli usredotočiti na klijente, brže provoditi daljnje postupke i unaprijediti poslove.

Sales donosi agenta Sales u Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook i Teams za korisnike aplikacija Dynamics 365 Sales i Salesforce CRM. Paket obuhvaća i dodatak Dynamics 365 za aplikaciju Copilot.

Upotrebljavajte Sales za pripremu sastanaka s klijentima, praćenje poslova, izradu skica relevantnih poruka za daljnje postupanje te dobivanje uvida i preporuka generiranih umjetnom inteligencijom. Sales se povezuje s aplikacijom Dynamics 365 Sales ili rješenjem Salesforce CRM radi pružanja podataka i mogućnosti prodaje u tim okruženjima.

Korisnici Salesforce CRM-a moraju imati licencu za Microsoft 365 Copilot. Korisnici aplikacije Dynamics 365 Sales moraju imati odgovarajuću licencu za Dynamics 365. Potrebno je postavljanje administratora, a pristup određenim okruženjima ovisi o licenci korisnika, pravu i pristupu relevantnom Microsoftovu proizvodu.

**Postavljanje i rukovanje podacima**

Sales omogućuje administratorima i korisnicima pristup sadržaju i dijeljenje podataka izvan sustava Microsoft 365, uključujući i usluge za upravljanje odnosima s korisnicima (CRM) trećih strana. Takvo dijeljenje podataka podliježe uvjetima i odredbama CRM usluge tvrtke Microsoft i trećih strana, gdje je primjenjivo. Dijeljenje podataka nije omogućeno dok administratori i korisnici u vašoj organizaciji ne pristanu na povezivanje svog poslovnog ili školskog Microsoft računa sa svojim računom CRM usluge.

Rješenje Sales u značajci Microsoft 365 Copilot imat će dopuštenje za sudjelovanje u sastancima na servisu Microsoft Teams i prikupljanje podataka o sastanku na servisu Teams, kao što su snimke sastanaka i transkripti.

Kada administrator implementira, Sales će imati dopuštenje za automatski pregled popisa primatelja e-pošte i obveza prilikom slanja e-pošte ili stvaranja ili izmjene obveze. To podržava radnje kao što su predlaganje novih kontakata za dodavanje u CRM sustav i prikaz relevantnih CRM informacija.

**Otkrijte više:**
– [Istražite što je moguće s rješenjem Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Najčešća pitanja o rješenju Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dokumentacija za Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Szerezzen értékesítési kontextust és végezzen műveleteket ott, ahol dolgozik – így az ügyfelekre összpontosíthat, gyorsabban végezheti el az utánkövetést, és előreviheti az ügyleteket.

Az Értékesítés a Dynamics 365 Sales és a Salesforce CRM felhasználói számára elérhetővé teszi az értékesítési ügynököt a Microsoft 365 Copilotban, az Outlookban és a Teamsben. A csomag a Copilot Cowork, a Copilot Code és a Microsoft Scout számára készült Dynamics 365 Sales-beépülő modult is tartalmazza.

Az Értékesítés használatával felkészülhet az ügyfélértekezletekre, áttekintheti az ügyletek állapotát, megírhatja a kapcsolódó utánkövető üzenetek piszkozatát, valamint AI által létrehozott megállapításokat és javaslatokat kaphat. Az Értékesítés a Dynamics 365 Saleshez vagy a Salesforce CRM-hez csatlakozik, hogy értékesítési adatokat és funkciókat biztosítson ezeken a felületeken.

A Salesforce-felhasználóknak Microsoft 365 Copilot-licencre van szükségük. A Dynamics 365 Sales-felhasználóknak megfelelő Dynamics 365-licencre van szükségük. Rendszergazdai beállítás szükséges, az egyes felületekhez való hozzáférés pedig a felhasználó licencétől, jogosultságától és a megfelelő Microsoft-termékhez való hozzáférésétől függ.

**Beállítás és adatkezelés**

Az Értékesítés segítségével a rendszergazdák és a felhasználók hozzáférhetnek tartalmakhoz és megoszthatják az adatokat a Microsoft 365-ön kívül, beleértve a harmadik féltől származó ügyfélkapcsolat-kezelési (CRM) szolgáltatásokat is. Az ilyen adatmegosztás a Microsoft és a harmadik fél alkalmazandó CRM-feltételeinek hatálya alá tartozik. Az adatmegosztás csak akkor engedélyezett, ha a szervezet rendszergazdái és felhasználói hozzájárulnak ahhoz, hogy munkahelyi vagy iskolai Microsoft-fiókjukat összekapcsolják CRM-fiókjukkal.

A Microsoft 365 Copilotban elérhető Értékesítés megoldás engedéllyel rendelkezik majd arra vonatkozóan, hogy részt vegyen a Microsoft Teams-értekezleteken és begyűjtse a Teams-értekezletek adatait, például az értekezleten készült felvételeket és átiratokat.

Amikor az Értékesítést rendszergazda telepíti, engedélye lesz arra, hogy e-mailek küldése, valamint találkozók létrehozása és módosítása alkalmával automatikusan ellenőrizze az e-mailek és a találkozók címzettlistáit. agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity's recorded representation needs to be compared with dated business evidence to identify drift, stale or incomplete values, contradictions, and unsupported claims. agentSkills.description: Create a buyer-specific proposal or bid presentation responding to explicit requirements or an RFP, with coverage, evidence, delivery, commercials and limits. agentSkills.description: Required for general-purpose customer Pitch Decks: cold first meetings, warm-lead product introductions, industry pitches, and internal enablement. Use for "pitch our product to a new buyer" or "introduce our solution". Do NOT use for formal RFPs or buyer-requirement proposals, investor/fundraising pitches, QBRs, account plans, pipeline reports, or edits.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-sales-pitch

agentSkills.description: Use when the user explicitly requests a sales results or forecast summary deck for senior leadership, highlighting expected outcomes, material risks and decisions requiring executive support. Use for "build a sales results deck for our leaders" or "create forecast summary slides for the VP". localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Dapatkan konteks dan tindakan penjualan di mana Anda sudah bekerja—sehingga Anda dapat fokus pada pelanggan, menindaklanjuti lebih cepat, dan memajukan penawaran.

Penjualan menghadirkan agen Penjualan ke Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook, dan Teams untuk pengguna Dynamics 365 Sales dan Salesforce CRM. Paket ini juga menyertakan plugin Dynamics 365 untuk aplikasi Copilot.

Gunakan Penjualan untuk mempersiapkan rapat pelanggan, mengikuti penawaran, membuat draf tindak lanjut yang relevan, serta mendapatkan wawasan dan rekomendasi yang dihasilkan AI. Penjualan terhubung ke Dynamics 365 Sales atau Salesforce CRM untuk memberikan data penjualan dan kemampuan dalam pengalaman ini.

Pengguna Salesforce memerlukan lisensi Microsoft 365 Copilot. Pengguna Dynamics 365 Sales memerlukan lisensi Dynamics 365 yang memenuhi syarat. Penyiapan administrator diperlukan, dan akses ke pengalaman tertentu tergantung pada lisensi, penetapan, dan akses pengguna ke produk Microsoft yang relevan.

**Penyiapan dan penanganan data**

Penjualan memungkinkan administrator dan pengguna mengakses konten serta berbagi data di luar Microsoft 365, termasuk dengan layanan manajemen hubungan pelanggan (CRM) pihak ketiga. Berbagi data tunduk pada syarat dan ketentuan Microsoft serta CRM pihak ketiga yang berlaku. Berbagi data tidak diaktifkan sampai administrator dan pengguna di organisasi Anda menyetujui untuk menyambungkan akun kerja atau sekolah Microsoft mereka dengan akun CRM.

Penjualan di Microsoft 365 Copilot akan memiliki izin untuk berpartisipasi dalam rapat Microsoft Teams dan mengumpulkan data rapat Teams, seperti rekaman dan transkrip rapat.

Saat disebarkan oleh administrator, Penjualan akan memiliki izin untuk meninjau daftar penerima email dan janji temu secara otomatis saat mengirim email atau membuat maupun mengubah janji temu. Tindakan ini mendukung tindakan seperti menyarankan kontak baru untuk penambahan ke sistem CRM dan menampilkan informasi CRM yang relevan.

**Temukan lainnya:**
- [Jelajahi hal-hal yang dapat dilakukan dengan Penjualan](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [FAQ Penjualan](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dokumentasi Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Ottieni il contesto e le azioni relativi alle vendite a cui lavori già, in modo da concentrarti sui clienti, eseguire il completamento più rapidamente e portare avanti le trattative.

Sales inserisce l'Agente di vendita in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook e Teams per gli utenti di Dynamics 365 Sales e Salesforce CRM. Il pacchetto include anche il plug-in Dynamics 365 per l'app Copilot.

Usa Sales per prepararti alle riunioni con i clienti, aggiornarti sulle trattative, creare bozze di completamenti pertinenti, nonché ottenere informazioni dettagliate e consigli generati dall'IA. Sales si connette a Dynamics 365 Sales o Salesforce CRM per fornire dati e funzionalità sulle vendite in queste esperienze.

Per gli utenti di Salesforce è necessaria una licenza di Microsoft 365 Copilot. Per gli utenti di Dynamics 365 Sales sono necessarie licenze idonee di Dynamics 365. È necessaria la configurazione dell'amministratore e l'accesso alle esperienze specifiche dipende dalle licenze, dai diritti e dall'accesso dell'utente al prodotto Microsoft pertinente.

**Configurazione e gestione dei dati**

Sales consente ad amministratori e utenti di accedere a contenuti e condividere dati al di fuori di Microsoft 365, anche con servizi CRM (Customer Relationship Management) di terze parti. Tale condivisione dei dati è soggetta alle condizioni di Microsoft e del servizio CRM di terze parti applicabili. La condivisione dei dati non viene abilitata finché gli amministratori e gli utenti dell'organizzazione non acconsentono a connettere il loro account Microsoft aziendale o dell'istituto di istruzione al loro account CRM.

Sales di Microsoft 365 Copilot disporrà dell'autorizzazione a partecipare alle riunioni di Microsoft Teams e raccogliere dati relativi alle riunioni di Teams, tra cui registrazioni e trascrizioni.

Quando viene distribuita da un amministratore, l'app Sales è autorizzata a controllare automaticamente gli elenchi di destinatari di e-mail e appuntamenti durante l'invio di e-mail o la creazione e la modifica di appuntamenti. Ciò supporta azioni come il suggerimento di nuovi contatti da aggiungere al sistema CRM e la visualizzazione di informazioni CRM pertinenti.

**Scopri di più:**
- [Esplora le funzionalità di Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Domande frequenti relative a Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Documentazione di Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
すでに業務を行っている場所で営業に関するコンテキストやアクションを利用できるため、顧客対応に集中し、より迅速にフォローアップし、案件を前に進めることができます。

Sales は、Dynamics 365 Sales と Salesforce CRM のユーザー向けに、Sales エージェントを Microsoft 365 Copilot、Outlook、Teams に提供します。パッケージには、Copilot アプリ用の Dynamics 365 プラグインも含まれています。

Sales を使用すると、顧客との会議を準備し、案件の状況を把握し、関連するフォローアップの下書きを作成し、AI によって生成された分析情報や推奨事項を取得できます。Sales は Dynamics 365 Sales または Salesforce CRM に接続し、これらのエクスペリエンスで営業データや機能を提供します。

Salesforce ユーザーには、Microsoft 365 Copilot ライセンスが必要です。Dynamics 365 Sales ユーザーには、対象となる Dynamics 365 ライセンスが必要です。管理者によるセットアップが必要です。また、特定のエクスペリエンスへのアクセスは、ユーザーのライセンス、権利、該当する Microsoft 製品へのアクセスによって異なります。

**セットアップとデータの取り扱い**

Sales を利用すると、管理者とユーザーは、コンテンツにアクセスし、Microsoft 365 の外部 (サード パーティの顧客関係管理 (CRM) サービスなど) とデータを共有できます。このようなデータの共有には、Microsoft および該当するサード パーティ CRM の契約条件が適用されます。データの共有は、組織内の管理者とユーザーが、Microsoft の職場または学校アカウントをそれぞれの CRM アカウントと接続することに同意するまで有効になりません。

Sales in Microsoft 365 Copilot には、Microsoft Teams 会議に参加し、Teams 会議データ (会議の記録、トランスクリプトなど) を収集するアクセス許可が付与されます。

管理者によって展開されると、Sales には、メール送信時や予定の作成/変更時にメールおよび予定の受信者リストを自動的にレビューするアクセス許可が付与されます。これにより、CRM システムに追加する新しい連絡先の提案や、関連する CRM 情報の表示などのアクションが可能になります。

**より詳しく知る:**
- [Sales でできることを確認する](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Sales に関する FAQ](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 のドキュメント](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Сатылым контексі мен әрекеттерін тікелей жұмыс істеп отырған жеріңізден алыңыз — осылайша тұтынушыларға назар аударып, кейінгі әрекеттерді жылдамырақ орындап, мәмілелерді ілгерілете аласыз.

Sales жүйесі Dynamics 365 Sales және Salesforce CRM пайдаланушылары үшін Сатылым агентін Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook және Teams қызметтеріне қосады. Бумаға Copilot бағдарламасына арналған Dynamics 365 плагині де кіреді.

Sales жүйесін тұтынушылармен кездесулерге дайындалу, мәмілелер бойынша соңғы ақпаратты білу, тиісті кейінгі хабарлардың жоба жазбасын дайындау және ЖИ арқылы жасалған аналитика мен ұсыныстарды алу үшін пайдаланыңыз. Sales жүйесі осы орталарда сатылым деректері мен мүмкіндіктерін ұсыну үшін Dynamics 365 Sales немесе Salesforce CRM жүйесіне қосылады.

Salesforce пайдаланушыларына Microsoft 365 Copilot лицензиясы қажет. Dynamics 365 Sales пайдаланушыларына жарамды Dynamics 365 лицензиясы қажет. Әкімші реттеуі қажет, ал нақты мүмкіндіктерге қатынасу пайдаланушының лицензиясына, пайдалану құқығына және тиісті Microsoft өніміне қатынасу мүмкіндігіне байланысты.

**Реттеу және деректерді өңдеу**

Sales жүйесі әкімшілер мен пайдаланушыларға мазмұнға қол жеткізуге және деректерді Microsoft 365 жүйесінен тыс, соның ішінде үшінші тараптың тұтынушылармен қарым-қатынасты басқару (CRM) қызметтерімен бөлісуге мүмкіндік береді. Мұндай деректерді бөлісу Microsoft пен тиісті үшінші тарап CRM шарттары мен талаптарына сай жүргізіледі. Ұйымыңыздағы әкімшілер мен пайдаланушылар Microsoft жұмыс немесе мектеп тіркелгісін CRM тіркелгісімен байланыстыруға келісім бермейінше, деректерді бөлісу іске қосылмайды.

Microsoft 365 Copilot жүйесіндегі Sales агентіне Microsoft Teams жиналыстарына қатысуға және жиналыс жазбалары мен транскрипциялары сияқты Teams жиналысының деректерін жинауға рұқсат беріледі.

Әкімші орналастырған кезде, Sales жүйесіне электрондық хабарларды жіберу немесе кездесулерді жасау не өзгерту кезінде электрондық хабарлар мен кездесулерді алушылар тізімдерін автоматты түрде қарап шығуға рұқсат беріледі. Бұл CRM жүйесіне қосу үшін жаңа контактілерді ұсыну және тиісті CRM ақпаратын көрсету сияқты әрекеттерді қолдайды.

**Қосымша ақпарат:**
- [Sales жүйесінің мүмкіндіктерімен танысу](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Sales туралы жиі қойылатын сұрақтар](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 құжаттамасы](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
여러분이 이미 일하고 있는 곳에서 영업 관련 컨텍스트와 작업을 확인하세요. 고객에게 집중하고, 더 빠르게 후속 조치를 취하며, 거래를 진전시킬 수 있습니다.

Sales는 Dynamics 365 Sales 및 Salesforce CRM 사용자를 위해 Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook, Teams에서 영업 에이전트를 제공합니다. 이 패키지에는 Copilot 앱용 Dynamics 365 플러그인도 포함되어 있습니다.

Sales를 사용하면 고객 회의를 준비하고, 거래 진행 상황을 파악하고, 관련 후속 메시지를 작성해 임시보관함에 저장하고, AI가 생성한 인사이트와 추천을 확인할 수 있습니다. Sales는 Dynamics 365 Sales 또는 Salesforce CRM에 연결되어 이러한 환경에서 영업 데이터와 기능을 제공합니다.

Salesforce 사용자는 Microsoft 365 Copilot 라이선스가 필요합니다. Dynamics 365 Sales 사용자는 적격 Dynamics 365 라이선스가 필요합니다. 관리자 설정도 필요하며, 특정 환경에 액세스할 수 있는지는 사용자의 라이선스, 권리 유형, 관련 Microsoft 제품에 대한 액세스 권한에 따라 달라집니다.

**설정 및 데이터 처리**

Sales를 사용하면 관리자와 사용자가 타사 CRM(고객 관계 관리) 서비스를 포함하여 Microsoft 365 외부에서 콘텐츠에 액세스하고 데이터를 공유할 수 있습니다. 이러한 데이터 공유에는 Microsoft 및 해당하는 타사의 CRM 사용 약관이 적용됩니다. 조직의 관리자와 사용자가 Microsoft 회사 또는 학교 계정을 CRM 계정에 연결하는 데 동의해야만 데이터 공유가 활성화됩니다.

Microsoft 365 Copilot의 Sales는 Microsoft Teams 모임에 참여하고 모임 녹음 및 대화록과 같은 Teams 모임 데이터를 수집할 수 있는 권한을 보유합니다.

관리자가 배포하면, Sales는 이메일을 보내거나 약속을 생성 또는 수정할 때 이메일 및 약속 수신자 목록을 자동으로 검토할 권한이 부여됩니다. 이를 통해 CRM 시스템에 추가할 새 연락처를 제안하고 관련 CRM 정보를 표시할 수 있습니다.

**자세히 알아보기:**
- [Sales로 가능한 작업 살펴보기](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Sales FAQ](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 설명서](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Gaukite pardavimo kontekstą ir atlikite veiksmus ten, kur jau dirbate, kad galėtumėte sutelkti dėmesį į klientus, greičiau imtis tolesnių veiksmų ir paspartinti sandorių eigą.

„Sales“ suteikia Pardavimo agentą „Microsoft 365 Copilot“, „Outlook“ ir „Teams“ vartotojams, naudojantiems „Dynamics 365 Sales“ ir „Salesforce CRM“. Į paketą taip pat įtrauktas „Copilot“ programai skirtas „Dynamics 365“ papildinys.

Naudokite „Sales“, kad pasiruoštumėte susitikimams su klientais, peržiūrėtumėte sandorių eigą, rengtumėte aktualių tolesnių veiksmų juodraščius ir gautumėte DI sugeneruotų įžvalgų bei rekomendacijų. „Sales“ prisijungia prie „Dynamics 365 Sales“ arba „Salesforce CRM“, kad šiose aplinkose pateiktų pardavimo duomenis ir funkcijas.

„Salesforce“ vartotojams reikalinga „Microsoft 365 Copilot“ licencija. „Dynamics 365 Sales“ vartotojams reikalinga tinkama „Dynamics 365“ licencija. Būtina administratoriaus atliekama sąranka, o prieiga prie konkrečių aplinkų priklauso nuo naudotojo licencijos, teisių suteikimo ir prieigos prie atitinkamo „Microsoft“ produkto.

**Sąranka ir duomenų tvarkymas**

„Sales“ suteikia administratoriams ir vartotojams galimybę pasiekti turinį ir bendrinti duomenis už „Microsoft 365“ ribų, pavyzdžiui, su trečiųjų šalių ryšių su klientais valdymo (CRM) paslaugomis. Tokiam duomenų bendrinimui taikomos „Microsoft“ ir atitinkamų trečiųjų šalių CRM sąlygos. Duomenų bendrinimas įjungiamas tik kai jūsų organizacijos administratoriai ir vartotojai sutinka sujungti savo „Microsoft“ darbo arba mokymo įstaigos paskyras su savo CRM paskyra.

„Microsoft 365 Copilot“ sprendimas „Sales“ turės leidimą dalyvauti „Microsoft Teams“ susitikimuose ir rinkti „Teams“ susitikimų duomenis, pavyzdžiui, susitikimų įrašus ir nuorašus.

Kai administratorius atliks visuotinį diegimą, „Sales“ turės teisę automatiškai peržiūrėti el. laiškų ir susitikimų gavėjų sąrašus, kai bus siunčiami el. laiškai arba kuriami ar keičiami susitikimai. Tai leidžia, pvz., siūlyti į CRM sistemą įtraukti naujus kontaktus ir rodyti aktualią CRM informaciją.

**Atraskite daugiau:**
– [Sužinokite, ką įmanoma nuveikti naudojant „Sales“](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
– [„Sales“ DUK](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
– [„Dynamics 365“ dokumentacija](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)
