localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Iegūstiet pārdošanas kontekstu un iespēju veikt darbības tur, kur jau strādājat, lai varētu koncentrēties uz klientiem, ātrāk veikt turpmākās darbības un virzīt darījumus uz priekšu.

Programma Sales nodrošina piekļuvi pārdošanas aģentam pakalpojumos Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook un Teams tiem lietotājiem, kuri izmanto Dynamics 365 Sales un Salesforce CRM. Pakotnē ir iekļauts arī Dynamics 365 spraudnis Copilot programmai.

Lietojiet programmu Sales, lai sagatavotos sapulcēm ar klientiem, noskaidrotu jaunāko informāciju par darījumiem, sagatavotu atbilstošu saziņas turpinājumu melnrakstus un iegūtu mākslīgā intelekta ģenerētus ieskatus un ieteikumus. Programma Sales izveido savienojumu ar Dynamics 365 Sales vai Salesforce CRM, lai šajās vidēs nodrošinātu pārdošanas datus un iespējas.

Salesforce lietotājiem ir nepieciešama Microsoft 365 Copilot licence. Dynamics 365 Sales lietotājiem ir nepieciešama atbilstoša Dynamics 365 licence. Nepieciešama administratora iestatīšana, un piekļuve konkrētām vidēm ir atkarīga no lietotāja licences, pilnvarām un piekļuves attiecīgajam Microsoft produktam.

**Iestatīšana un datu apstrāde**

Sales sniedz iespēju administratoriem un lietotājiem piekļūt saturam un kopīgot datus ārpus Microsoft 365, tostarp ar trešo pušu klientu attiecību pārvaldības (CRM) pakalpojumiem. Šāda datu koplietošana tiek veikta saskaņā ar Microsoft un attiecīgo trešo pušu CRM noteikumiem un nosacījumiem. Datu koplietošana netiek iespējota, kamēr jūsu organizācijas administratori un lietotāji nav piekrituši savienot savu Microsoft darba vai mācību kontu ar CRM kontu.

Sales risinājumam programmā Microsoft 365 Copilot būs atļauja piedalīties Microsoft Teams sapulcēs un apkopot Teams sapulču datus, piemēram, sapulču ierakstus un norakstus.

Ja administrators ir izvietojis Sales pakalpojumu, tam būs atļauja automātiski pārskatīt e-pasta un tikšanās adresātu sarakstus, nosūtot e-pasta ziņojumus vai izveidojot un modificējot tikšanās. Tas atbalsta tādas darbības kā jaunu kontaktpersonu ieteikšana pievienošanai CRM sistēmai un atbilstošas CRM informācijas parādīšana.

**Atklāt vairāk:**

- [Bieži uzdotie jautājumi par Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 dokumentācija](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Get sales context and actions where you already work—so you can focus on customers, follow up faster, and move deals forward.

Sales brings the Sales agent to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook, and Teams for users of Dynamics 365 Sales and Salesforce CRM. The package also includes the Dynamics 365 plugin for the Copilot app.

Use Sales to prepare for customer meetings, catch up on deals, draft relevant follow-ups, and get AI-generated insights and recommendations. Sales connects to Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce CRM to provide sales data and capabilities in these experiences.

Salesforce users require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Dynamics 365 Sales users require eligible Dynamics 365 licensing. Administrator setup is required, and access to specific experiences depends on the user’s licensing, entitlement, and access to the relevant Microsoft product.

**Setup and data handling**

Sales allows administrators and users to access content and share data outside of Microsoft 365, including with third-party customer relationship management (CRM) services. Such data sharing is subject to Microsoft and applicable third-party CRM terms and conditions. Data sharing is not enabled until administrators and users in your organization consent to connect their Microsoft work or school account with their CRM account.

Sales in Microsoft 365 Copilot will have permission to participate in Microsoft Teams meetings and collect Teams meeting data such as meeting recordings and transcripts.

When deployed by an administrator, Sales will have permission to automatically review email and appointment recipient lists when sending emails or creating or modifying appointments. This supports actions such as suggesting new contacts for addition to the CRM system and displaying relevant CRM information.

**Discover more:**
- [Explore what’s possible with Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Sales FAQ](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Få salgskontekst og handlinger der du allerede arbeider – slik at du kan fokusere på kunder, følge opp raskere og flytte avtaler fremover.

Salg bringer salgsagenten til Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook og Teams for brukere av Dynamics 365 Sales og Salesforce CRM. Pakken inkluderer også Dynamics 365-programtillegget for Copilot-appen.

Bruk Salg til å forberede kundemøter, holde deg oppdatert på avtaler, lage utkast til relevante oppfølginger og få KI-generert innsikt og anbefalinger. Salg kobles til Dynamics 365 Sales eller Salesforce CRM for å levere salgsdata og -funksjoner i disse opplevelsene.

Salesforce-brukere krever en Microsoft 365 Copilot-lisens. Dynamics 365 Sales-brukere krever kvalifisert Dynamics 365-lisensiering. Administratoroppsett kreves, og tilgang til bestemte opplevelser avhenger av brukerens lisensiering, rettighet og tilgang til det relevante Microsoft-produktet.

**Oppsett og databehandling**

Med Sales kan administratorer og brukere få tilgang til innhold og dele data utenfor Microsoft 365, inkludert med kunderelasjonssystemer (CRM) fra tredjeparter. Slik datadeling er underlagt Microsofts og gjeldende tredjeparts CRM-vilkår og -betingelser. Datadeling er ikke aktivert før administratorer og brukere i organisasjonen samtykker i å koble Microsoft jobb- eller skolekontoen til CRM-kontoen sin.

Salg i Microsoft 365 Copilot har tillatelse til å delta i Microsoft Teams-møter og samle inn Teams-møtedata, for eksempel møteopptak og transkripsjoner.

Når Salg distribueres av en administrator, har Salg tillatelse til automatisk å gå gjennom e-post- og avtalemottakerlister ved sending av e-poster eller opprettelse eller endring av avtaler. Dette støtter handlinger som å foreslå nye kontakter for å legge til i CRM-systemet og vise relevant CRM-informasjon.

**Oppdag mer:**
– [Utforsk hva som er mulig med Salg](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
– [Vanlige spørsmål om Salg](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)

agentSkills.description: Use before one customer meeting or sales interaction to prepare an evidence-backed objective, participant brief, relevant context, open commitments, agenda, questions, talking points, risks, and desired outcomes. agentSkills.description: Required for general-purpose customer Pitch Decks: cold first meetings, warm-lead product introductions, industry pitches, and internal enablement. agentSkills.description: Use when the user explicitly requests a sales results or forecast summary deck for senior leadership, highlighting expected outcomes, material risks and decisions requiring executive support. localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Krijg verkoopcontext en acties op de plek waar je al werkt, zodat je je op klanten kunt richten, sneller kunt opvolgen en deals kunt bevorderen.

Sales brengt de verkoopagent naar Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook en Teams voor gebruikers van Dynamics 365 Sales en Salesforce CRM. Het pakket bevat ook de Dynamics 365-plugin voor de Copilot-app.

Gebruik Sales om je voor te bereiden op klantvergaderingen, bij te praten over deals, relevante opvolgingen op te stellen en door AI gegenereerde inzichten en aanbevelingen te krijgen. Sales maakt verbinding met Dynamics 365 Sales of Salesforce CRM om verkoopgegevens en mogelijkheden in deze ervaringen beschikbaar te stellen.

Salesforce-gebruikers hebben een Microsoft 365 Copilot-licentie nodig. Dynamics 365 Sales-gebruikers hebben een in aanmerking komende Dynamics 365-licentie nodig. Configuratie door een beheerder is vereist. Toegang tot specifieke ervaringen is afhankelijk van de licenties en rechten van de gebruiker en diens toegang tot het relevante Microsoft-product.

**Configuratie en gegevensverwerking**

Sales stelt beheerders en gebruikers in staat om inhoud te openen en gegevens te delen buiten Microsoft 365, ook met CRM-services van derden. De voorwaarden van Microsoft en het betreffende CRM van de derde partij zijn van toepassing bij het delen van deze gegevens. Het delen van gegevens wordt pas ingeschakeld wanneer beheerders en gebruikers in je organisatie toestemming hebben gegeven om hun Microsoft-werk- of schoolaccount te koppelen aan hun CRM-account.

Sales in Microsoft 365 Copilot krijgt toestemming om deel te nemen aan Microsoft Teams-vergaderingen en Teams-vergadergegevens te verzamelen, zoals opnamen en transcripties van vergaderingen.

Wanneer Sales door een beheerder wordt geïmplementeerd, krijgt het toestemming om automatisch lijsten met ontvangers van e-mails en afspraken te controleren bij het verzenden van e-mails of het maken of wijzigen van afspraken. Dit ondersteunt acties zoals het voorstellen van nieuwe contactpersonen om aan het CRM-systeem toe te voegen en het weergeven van relevante CRM-informatie.

**Meer ontdekken:**
- [Ontdek wat mogelijk is met Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Veelgestelde vragen over Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365-documentatie](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Uzyskuj kontekst i akcje sprzedażowe tam, gdzie już pracujesz – dzięki temu możesz skupić się na klientach, szybciej podejmować dalsze działania i sprawniej finalizować transakcje.

Usługa Sales udostępnia agenta sprzedaży w aplikacji Microsoft 365 Copilot, programie Outlook i usłudze Teams użytkownikom aplikacji Dynamics 365 Sales oraz systemu Salesforce CRM. Pakiet zawiera także wtyczkę Dynamics 365 dla aplikacji Copilot.

Używaj usługi Sales, aby przygotowywać się do spotkań z klientami, sprawdzać postępy w transakcjach, tworzyć wersje robocze odpowiednich wiadomości uzupełniających oraz uzyskiwać szczegółowe informacje i rekomendacje wygenerowane przez AI. Usługa Sales łączy się z aplikacją Dynamics 365 Sales lub systemem Salesforce CRM, aby zapewniać dane i możliwości sprzedażowe w tych środowiskach.

Użytkownicy usługi Salesforce wymagają licencji Microsoft 365 Copilot. Użytkownicy aplikacji Dynamics 365 Sales wymagają odpowiedniej licencji na rozwiązanie Dynamics 365. Wymagana jest konfiguracja przez administratora, a dostęp do poszczególnych środowisk zależy od licencji użytkownika, uprawnień i dostępu do odpowiedniego produktu firmy Microsoft.

**Konfiguracja i obsługa danych**

Funkcja Sales umożliwia administratorom i użytkownikom dostęp do zawartości oraz udostępnianie danych poza platformą Microsoft 365, w tym w usługach zarządzania relacjami z klientami (CRM) innych firm. Takie udostępnianie danych podlega postanowieniom firmy Microsoft i odpowiednich usług CRM innych firm. Udostępnianie danych nie jest włączone, dopóki administratorzy i użytkownicy w organizacji nie wyrażą zgody na połączenie swojego konta służbowego Microsoft z kontem systemu CRM.

Usługa Sales w aplikacji Microsoft 365 Copilot będzie mieć uprawnienia do uczestniczenia w spotkaniach w Microsoft Teams i zbierania danych ze spotkań w usłudze Teams, takich jak nagrania i transkrypcje.

W przypadku wdrożenia przez administratora usługa Sales będzie mieć uprawnienia do automatycznego przeglądania list adresatów wiadomości e-mail i terminów podczas wysyłania wiadomości e-mail oraz tworzenia lub modyfikowania terminów. Umożliwia to wykonywanie akcji takich jak sugerowanie nowych kontaktów do dodania do systemu CRM i wyświetlanie odpowiednich informacji z systemu CRM.

**Odkryj więcej:**
– [Poznaj możliwości usługi Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
– [Często zadawane pytania dotyczące usługi Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
– [Dokumentacja rozwiązania Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Tenha contexto e ações de vendas onde você já trabalha — assim, você pode se concentrar nos clientes, fazer acompanhamentos mais rapidamente e avançar nos negócios.

O Sales leva o Agente de Vendas ao Microsoft 365 Copilot, ao Outlook e ao Teams para usuários do Dynamics 365 Sales e do Salesforce CRM. O pacote também inclui o plug-in do Dynamics 365 para o aplicativo Copilot.

Use o Sales para se preparar para reuniões com clientes, ficar por dentro de negócios, redigir acompanhamentos relevantes e receber insights e recomendações gerados por IA. O Sales se conecta ao Dynamics 365 Sales ou ao Salesforce CRM para fornecer dados e recursos de vendas nessas experiências.

Os usuários do Salesforce precisam de uma licença do Microsoft 365 Copilot. Os usuários do Dynamics 365 Sales precisam de uma licença qualificada do Dynamics 365. É necessária a configuração de um administrador. O acesso a experiências específicas depende da licença, do direito do usuário e do acesso ao produto relevante da Microsoft.

**Configuração e tratamento de dados**

O Sales permite que administradores e usuários acessem conteúdo e compartilhem dados fora do Microsoft 365, inclusive com serviços de CRM (gerenciamento de relacionamento com o cliente) de terceiros. Esse compartilhamento de dados está sujeito aos termos e condições da Microsoft e do CRM de terceiros aplicáveis. O compartilhamento de dados não é habilitado até que administradores e usuários da sua organização consintam em conectar a conta corporativa ou de estudante da Microsoft à conta de CRM.

O Sales no Microsoft 365 Copilot terá permissão para participar de reuniões do Microsoft Teams e coletar dados de reuniões do Teams, como gravações e transcrições de reuniões.

Quando implantado por um administrador, o Sales terá permissão para examinar automaticamente as listas de destinatários de email e compromisso ao enviar emails ou ao criar ou modificar compromissos. Isso permite ações como sugerir novos contatos para adicionar ao sistema de CRM e exibir informações relevantes de CRM.

**Descubra mais:**
- [Explore o que é possível com o Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Perguntas frequentes do Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Documentação do Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Obțineți context și acțiuni de vânzări acolo unde lucrați deja, astfel încât să vă puteți concentra asupra clienților, să reveniți mai rapid și să avansați tranzacțiile.

Sales aduce agentul Sales în Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook și Teams pentru utilizatorii Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales și Salesforce CRM. Pachetul include și pluginul Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales pentru Copilot Cowork, Copilot Code și Microsoft Scout.

Folosiți Sales pentru a vă pregăti pentru întâlnirile cu clienții, pentru a vă pune la curent cu tranzacțiile, pentru a redacta mesaje de revenire relevante și pentru a obține detalii și recomandări generate de AI. Sales se conectează la Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales sau la Salesforce CRM pentru a furniza date și funcționalități de vânzări în aceste experiențe.

Utilizatorii Salesforce au nevoie de o licență Microsoft 365 Copilot. Utilizatorii Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales au nevoie de licențe Microsoft Dynamics 365 eligibile. Este necesară configurarea de către un administrator. Accesul la anumite experiențe depinde de licența utilizatorului, de drepturile acordate și de accesul la produsul Microsoft relevant.

**Configurarea și gestionarea datelor**

Sales le permite administratorilor și utilizatorilor să acceseze conținut și să partajeze date în afara Microsoft 365, inclusiv cu servicii terțe de gestionare a relațiilor cu clienții (CRM). Acest tip de partajare a datelor se supune termenilor și condițiilor aplicabile ale Microsoft și ale terților furnizori de servicii CRM. Partajarea datelor nu este activată până când administratorii și utilizatorii din organizația dvs. nu consimt să își conecteze la contul CRM contul Microsoft de la locul de muncă sau de la școală.

Sales din Microsoft 365 Copilot va avea permisiunea de a participa la întâlniri Microsoft Teams și de a colecta date despre întâlnirile din Teams, cum ar fi înregistrările întâlnirilor și transcrierile.

Când Sales este implementat de un administrator, va avea permisiunea de a revizui automat listele de destinatari ai e-mailurilor și ai rezervărilor atunci când trimiteți e-mailuri sau creați ori modificați programări. Astfel, sunt posibile acțiuni precum sugerarea unor contacte noi pentru adăugare în sistemul CRM și afișarea informațiilor relevante din CRM.

**Descoperiți mai multe:**
- [Explorați posibilitățile oferite de Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Întrebări frecvente despre Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Documentația Microsoft Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

agentSkills.description: Use when someone asks what happened with an account, opportunity, or contact; needs a deduplicated engagement timeline; or wants engagement changes, commitments, and stakeholder patterns before acting. Not for choosing the next buyer or following up on one meeting.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-activity-synthesis

agentSkills.description: Use to draft a decision-ready business case for one deal or initiative — the customer's baseline problem, the supported impact and cost of inaction, the proposed change and its contribution, and an investment and value case, tailored to a named audience. Produces a reviewable draft; saving or sending requires a separate, explicitly approved action. Not for a price or discount quote, and not for a generic capability pitch.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-business-case-composer

agentSkills.description: Use when a named or suspected competitor must be positioned against customer requirements, decision criteria, or objections for a specific opportunity. Not for generic market research or unsupported competitor claims.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-competitive-strategy

agentSkills.description: Use when a bounded set of sales records needs an evidence-based review for absent, malformed, stale, inconsistent, or unverified data and a proposed correction report. Also applies to an export or supplied table; not for deep reconciliation of one opportunity or team-performance review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-crm-data-hygiene

agentSkills.description: Use when an account needs a phased engagement plan across stakeholders, coverage gaps, relationship paths, and business objectives. Use a 30-day horizon when requested; not for choosing only the immediate next buyer.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-customer-engagement-strategy

agentSkills.description: Use to report what changed and why across a scoped set of deals since a stated baseline — which deals slipped, or what moved on a bounded top set since a point in time. Needs a defined scope and current deal evidence; a baseline improves the comparison, but a current-state result is available without one. Not for ranking what to work on next or a single deal's full standing review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-catchup

agentSkills.description: Use when a deal's product/price configuration needs to be built, judged for fit, or corrected, turned into a quote, and/or advanced to the next business-process stage — including reasoning about whether a proposed configuration is net-new, an expansion, or a renewal, and what it will actually cost.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-desk

agentSkills.description: Use when a seller or manager needs to test an alleged slowdown on one specific opportunity and decide whether it is a supported stall, a record-hygiene issue, or not currently supported by the evidence, then recommend recovery, restructuring, escalation, or disqualification. Not for a change digest across many deals, a leadership status review, cross-set ranking, or an ordinary healthy-deal lookup.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-rescue

agentSkills.description: Use to draft outreach for people the seller met whose pending asks need follow-up, or previously responsive open leads that have gone quiet. Ground drafts in substantive evidence and assess the contact policy for the actual purpose and channel. Produces reviewable text; saving or sending requires a separate, explicitly approved action. Not for a completed meeting's summary and action capture, choosing the next stakeholder, or cold prospecting.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-draft-outreach

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity needs a leadership-ready review of current state, material movement over a defined period, risks, decisions, and a specific leadership ask. Not for a team-wide pipeline review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-executive-deal-review

agentSkills.description: Use when one lead needs an evidence-backed assessment against an explicitly supplied qualification method, including criterion-level gaps, a disposition recommendation, and proposed routing. Not for inventing BANT, forcing a binary decision, or configuring an existing opportunity.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-lead-disposition

agentSkills.description: Use before one customer meeting or sales interaction to prepare an evidence-backed objective, participant brief, relevant context, open commitments, agenda, questions, talking points, risks, and desired outcomes. Works from supplied material; not for post-meeting capture, a phased account plan, or a seller's coaching agenda.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-meeting-prep

agentSkills.description: Use to produce a ranked worklist of which opportunities in a scoped set to work next and why now, weighing value, urgency, risk, momentum, and influenceability. Needs a defined opportunity scope and current opportunity evidence; a live engagement history improves the read but is not required. Not for reporting what changed on a set of deals, a single meeting brief, or a full team pipeline review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-pipeline-prioritizer

agentSkills.description: Use after one sales meeting or call to separate facts, decisions, commitments, and open topics; propose durable record updates and next actions; and draft follow-up communication when requested. Not for a broad account history or work-period capture.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-post-meeting-follow-up

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity's recorded representation needs to be compared with dated business evidence to identify drift, stale or incomplete values, contradictions, and unsupported claims. Works without current record access as a bounded observations report; not for a wide hygiene sweep.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-reconcile-my-opportunity

agentSkills.description: Use when an opportunity must be evaluated against explicit organizational requirements for a defined next stage, with each criterion marked met, unmet, unknown, or conflicting. Not for inferring readiness from a stage label or activity volume.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-stage-advance-readiness

agentSkills.description: turn sales, customer, usage, value, pipeline, and financial data from crm systems, excel workbooks, and other connected sources into one or more executive-ready powerpoint slides. use to visualize data, create charts or scorecards, add data-driven insights to a deck, update existing slides with current metrics, compare customers or periods, explain business performance, or build an executive sales narrative from quantitative data.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-visualize-sales-data

agentSkills.description: Use this skill first for creating a source-grounded internal account brief for a named customer or prospect - what matters to the customer, who matters in the decision, where we stand, which opportunities to validate, and what to do next. Saves an editable PowerPoint deck. Use for requests such as "create an account brief for Northstar", "build a briefing deck on this customer for our sales team", "make an account briefing deck from these notes and filings", or "prepare a prospect brief". Do NOT use for creating login or user accounts, preparing for one upcoming meeting or call unless a deck is asked for, customer-facing sales pitches, QBRs or adoption reviews, annual account plans with quotas or pipeline forecasts, summarizing or fact-checking an existing deck, drawing a reporting hierarchy alone, briefs wanted as a Word, PDF, or Markdown file, or research answered in chat with no brief file requested. For matching tasks, load this skill before any generic PowerPoint/presentation skill.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-account-brief

agentSkills.description: Create a buyer-specific proposal or bid presentation responding to explicit requirements or an RFP, with coverage, evidence, delivery, commercials and limits. Use for "respond to the buyer's requirements" or "prepare our RFP proposal deck". Do NOT use for a proactive customer product or solution pitch, investor pitches, customer business reviews, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-proposal-response

agentSkills.description: Required for general-purpose customer Pitch Decks: cold first meetings, warm-lead product introductions, industry pitches, and internal enablement. Use for "pitch our product to a new buyer" or "introduce our solution". Do NOT use for formal RFPs or buyer-requirement proposals, investor/fundraising pitches, QBRs, account plans, pipeline reports, or edits.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-sales-pitch

agentSkills.description: Use when the user explicitly requests a sales results or forecast summary deck for senior leadership, highlighting expected outcomes, material risks and decisions requiring executive support. Use for "build a sales results deck for our leaders" or "create forecast summary slides for the VP". Do NOT use for forecast or pipeline analysis answered in the conversation, one opportunity's leadership review unless a deck is asked for, deal-by-deal pipeline management, customer-facing business reviews, proactive pitches, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-executive-sales-summary

agentSkills.description: Prepare a seller to handle a specific customer''s likely objections. For each objection: the customer''s wording, discovery questions to ask live, a short evidence-backed response, the proof behind it or the evidence still missing, and a confirming next step. Delivered by default as a separate internal deck, or as removable slides appended to the current deck or kept in chat when the user asks. Use when the user asks to "prep me for this customer''s objections", "how do I answer their pushback on price", "build objection handling for this deal", "what will the buyer push back on and how should I respond", "objection responses for the concerns they raised on the call", or "talk tracks for handling procurement''s objections". Do NOT use to stress-test, score or find weaknesses in a presentation''s own argument, to play devil''s advocate, for general Q&A rehearsal, to write speaker notes or a talk track for the deck itself, or to build or redesign a pitch.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-prepare-objection-responses

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Получайте контекст продаж и действия там, где вы уже работаете, чтобы вы могли сосредоточиться на клиентах, быстрее выполнять последующие действия и продвигать сделки вперед.

Sales предоставляет агенту Sales доступ к Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook и Teams для пользователей Dynamics 365 Sales и Salesforce CRM. В пакет также входит плагин Dynamics 365 для приложения Copilot.

Используйте Sales, чтобы готовиться к встречам с клиентами, быстро вникать в ход сделок, составлять уместные последующие сообщения и получать аналитику и рекомендации на основе ИИ. Sales подключается к Dynamics 365 Sales или Salesforce CRM, чтобы предоставлять данные и возможности продаж в этих средах.

Пользователям Salesforce требуется лицензия Microsoft 365 Copilot. Пользователям Dynamics 365 Sales требуется соответствующая лицензия Dynamics 365. Необходима настройка администратором, а доступ к отдельным возможностям зависит от лицензирования, прав и доступа пользователя к соответствующему продукту Microsoft.

**Настройка и обработка данных**

Sales позволяет администраторам и пользователям получать доступ к контенту и обмениваться данными за пределами Microsoft 365, в том числе со сторонними службами управления отношениями с клиентами (CRM). Такая передача данных регулируется условиями корпорации Майкрософт и соответствующих сторонних CRM-систем. Обмен данными не будет включен, пока администраторы и пользователи вашей организации не дадут согласия на подключение своей рабочей или учебной учетной записи Майкрософт к своей учетной записи CRM.

Sales в Microsoft 365 Copilot будет иметь разрешение на участие в собраниях Microsoft Teams и сбор данных собраний Teams, таких как записи собраний и стенограммы.

Если развернуто администратором, будет разрешено Sales автоматически просматривать списки получателей адресов электронной почты и собраний при отправке писем или создании или изменении собраний. Это позволяет, например, предлагать новые контакты для добавления в систему CRM и отображать соответствующие сведения из CRM.

**Подробнее:**
– [Узнайте, что можно делать с помощью Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
– [Вопросы и ответы по Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
– [Документация по Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Získajte kontext predaja a možnosti vykonávania akcií priamo tam, kde už pracujete, aby ste sa mohli sústrediť na zákazníkov, rýchlejšie nadväzovali kontakt a posúvali obchodné príležitosti vpred.

Riešenie Sales prináša agenta Sales do aplikácií Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook a Teams pre používateľov aplikácií Dynamics 365 Sales a Salesforce CRM. Balík obsahuje aj doplnok Dynamics 365 Sales pre Copilot Cowork, Copilot Code a Microsoft Scout.

Pomocou riešenia Sales sa môžete pripraviť na stretnutia so zákazníkmi, získať prehľad o obchodných príležitostiach, vytvárať koncepty relevantných následných správ a získavať prehľady a odporúčania generované umelou inteligenciou. Riešenie Sales sa pripája k aplikácii Dynamics 365 Sales alebo Salesforce CRM a poskytuje v týchto prostrediach údaje a funkcie predaja.

Používatelia Salesforce potrebujú licenciu na Microsoft 365 Copilot. Používatelia Dynamics 365 Sales potrebujú oprávňujúcu licenciu na Dynamics 365. Vyžaduje sa nastavenie správcom a prístup ku konkrétnym prostrediam závisí od licencie používateľa, jeho nároku a prístupu k príslušnému produktu Microsoft.

**Nastavenie a spracovanie údajov**

Riešenie Sales umožňuje správcom a používateľom prístup k obsahu a zdieľanie údajov mimo Microsoftu 365 vrátane služieb riadenia vzťahov so zákazníkmi (CRM) tretích strán. Takéto zdieľanie údajov podlieha podmienkam a požiadavkám spoločnosti Microsoft a príslušných tretích strán poskytujúcich služby riadenia vzťahov so zákazníkmi (CRM). Zdieľanie údajov nie je povolené, kým správcovia a používatelia vo vašej organizácii nevyjadria súhlas s prepojením svojho pracovného alebo školského konta Microsoft so svojím kontom v systéme CRM.

Riešenie Sales v službe Microsoft 365 Copilot bude mať povolenie pripájať sa k schôdzam Microsoft Teams a zhromažďovať údaje o schôdzach Teams, ako sú záznamy a prepisy schôdze.

Ak riešenie Sales nasadí správca, bude mať povolenie automaticky kontrolovať zoznamy príjemcov e-mailov a schôdzí pri odosielaní e-mailov alebo vytváraní či úprave schôdzí. To umožňuje napríklad navrhovať nové kontakty na pridanie do systému CRM a zobrazovať relevantné informácie zo systému CRM.

**Objaviť viac:**
– [Preskúmajte, čo je možné s riešením Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)

agentSkills.description: Use when a named or suspected competitor must be positioned against customer requirements, decision criteria, or objections for a specific opportunity. Not for generic market research or unsupported competitor claims.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-competitive-strategy

agentSkills.description: Use when a bounded set of sales records needs an evidence-based review for absent, malformed, stale, inconsistent, or unverified data and a proposed correction report. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-crm-data-hygiene

agentSkills.description: Use when an account needs a phased engagement plan across stakeholders, coverage gaps, relationship paths, and business objectives. Use a 30-day horizon when requested; not for choosing only the immediate next buyer.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-customer-engagement-strategy

agentSkills.description: Use to report what changed and why across a scoped set of deals since a stated baseline — which deals slipped, or what moved on a bounded top set since a point in time. agentSkills.description: Use when a deal's product/price configuration needs to be built, judged for fit, or corrected, turned into a quote, and/or advanced to the next business-process stage — including reasoning about whether a proposed configuration is net-new, an expansion, or a renewal, and what it will actually cost.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-desk

agentSkills.description: Use when a seller or manager needs to test an alleged slowdown on one specific opportunity and decide whether it is a supported stall, a record-hygiene issue, or not currently supported by the evidence, then recommend recovery, restructuring, escalation, or disqualification. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-rescue

agentSkills.description: Use to draft outreach for people the seller met whose pending asks need follow-up, or previously responsive open leads that have gone quiet. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-draft-outreach

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity needs a leadership-ready review of current state, material movement over a defined period, risks, decisions, and a specific leadership ask. Not for a team-wide pipeline review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-executive-deal-review

agentSkills.description: Use when one lead needs an evidence-backed assessment against an explicitly supplied qualification method, including criterion-level gaps, a disposition recommendation, and proposed routing. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-lead-disposition

agentSkills.description: Use before one customer meeting or sales interaction to prepare an evidence-backed objective, participant brief, relevant context, open commitments, agenda, questions, talking points, risks, and desired outcomes. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-meeting-prep

agentSkills.description: Use to produce a ranked worklist of which opportunities in a scoped set to work next and why now, weighing value, urgency, risk, momentum, and influenceability. agentSkills.description: Use after one sales meeting or call to separate facts, decisions, commitments, and open topics; propose durable record updates and next actions; and draft follow-up communication when requested. Not for a broad account history or work-period capture.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-post-meeting-follow-up

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity's recorded representation needs to be compared with dated business evidence to identify drift, stale or incomplete values, contradictions, and unsupported claims. agentSkills.name: d365-sales-reconcile-my-opportunity

agentSkills.description: Use when an opportunity must be evaluated against explicit organizational requirements for a defined next stage, with each criterion marked met, unmet, unknown, or conflicting. Not for inferring readiness from a stage label or activity volume.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-stage-advance-readiness

agentSkills.description: turn sales, customer, usage, value, pipeline, and financial data from crm systems, excel workbooks, and other connected sources into one or more executive-ready powerpoint slides. use to visualize data, create charts or scorecards, add data-driven insights to a deck, update existing slides with current metrics, compare customers or periods, explain business performance, or build an executive sales narrative from quantitative data.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-visualize-sales-data

agentSkills.description: Use this skill first for creating a source-grounded internal account brief for a named customer or prospect - what matters to the customer, who matters in the decision, where we stand, which opportunities to validate, and what to do next. Use for requests such as "create an account brief for Northstar", "build a briefing deck on this customer for our sales team", "make an account briefing deck from these notes and filings", or "prepare a prospect brief". For matching tasks, load this skill before any generic PowerPoint/presentation skill.

agentSkills.description: Create a buyer-specific proposal or bid presentation responding to explicit requirements or an RFP, with coverage, evidence, delivery, commercials and limits. Use for "respond to the buyer's requirements" or "prepare our RFP proposal deck". Do NOT use for a proactive customer product or solution pitch, investor pitches, customer business reviews, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-proposal-response

agentSkills.description: Required for general-purpose customer Pitch Decks: cold first meetings, warm-lead product introductions, industry pitches, and internal enablement. Use for "pitch our product to a new buyer" or "introduce our solution". Do NOT use for formal RFPs or buyer-requirement proposals, investor/fundraising pitches, QBRs, account plans, pipeline reports, or edits.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-sales-pitch

agentSkills.description: Use when the user explicitly requests a sales results or forecast summary deck for senior leadership, highlighting expected outcomes, material risks and decisions requiring executive support. Use for "build a sales results deck for our leaders" or "create forecast summary slides for the VP". Do NOT use for forecast or pipeline analysis answered in the conversation, one opportunity's leadership review unless a deck is asked for, deal-by-deal pipeline management, customer-facing business reviews, proactive pitches, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-executive-sales-summary

agentSkills.description: Prepare a seller to handle a specific customer''s likely objections. For each objection: the customer''s wording, discovery questions to ask live, a short evidence-backed response, the proof behind it or the evidence still missing, and a confirming next step. Delivered by default as a separate internal deck, or as removable slides appended to the current deck or kept in chat when the user asks. Use when the user asks to "prep me for this customer''s objections", "how do I answer their pushback on price", "build objection handling for this deal", "what will the buyer push back on and how should I respond", "objection responses for the concerns they raised on the call", or "talk tracks for handling procurement''s objections". Do NOT use to stress-test, score or find weaknesses in a presentation''s own argument, to play devil''s advocate, for general Q&A rehearsal, to write speaker notes or a talk track for the deck itself, or to build or redesign a pitch.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-prepare-objection-responses

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Pridobite kontekst prodaje in ukrepe tam, kjer že delate, da se lahko osredotočite na stranke, hitreje ukrepate in pospešite sklepanje poslov.

Sales prinaša prodajnega posrednika v Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook in Teams za uporabnike storitev Dynamics 365 Sales in Salesforce CRM. Paket vključuje tudi vtičnik Dynamics 365 Sales za Copilot Cowork, Copilot Code in Microsoft Scout.

Uporabite Sales za pripravo na srečanja s strankami, pregled stanja poslov, pripravo ustreznih nadaljnjih korakov ter pridobivanje vpogledov in priporočil, ustvarjenih z UI. Sales se poveže s storitvijo Dynamics 365 Sales ali Salesforce CRM, da zagotovi podatke o prodaji in zmogljivosti v teh izkušnjah.

Uporabniki storitve Salesforce potrebujejo licenco za Microsoft 365 Copilot. Uporabniki storitve Dynamics 365 Sales potrebujejo ustrezno licenco za Dynamics 365. Zahtevana je nastavitev skrbnika, dostop do določenih funkcij pa je odvisen od uporabnikovega licenciranja, upravičenosti in dostopa do ustreznega Microsoftovega izdelka.

**Nastavitev in obdelava podatkov**

Sales omogoča skrbnikom in uporabnikom dostop do vsebine ter skupno rabo podatkov zunaj okolja Microsoft 365, vključno s storitvami upravljanja odnosov s strankami tretjih oseb. Takšna skupna raba podatkov je predmet pogojev in določil Microsofta ter ustreznih pogojev in določil upravljanja odnosov s strankami tretjih oseb. Skupna raba podatkov ni omogočena, dokler skrbniki in uporabniki v vaši organizaciji ne privolijo v povezavo svojega Microsoftovega službenega ali šolskega računa z računom za upravljanje odnosov s strankami.

Aplikacija Sales v storitvi Microsoft 365 Copilot bo imela dovoljenje za sodelovanje na srečanjih v aplikaciji Microsoft Teams in zbiranje podatkov o srečanjih v aplikaciji Teams, kot so posnetki in prepisi srečanj.

Ko skrbnik uvede storitev Sales, bo ta imela dovoljenje za samodejni pregled seznamov prejemnikov e-pošte in sestankov pri pošiljanju e-poštnih sporočil oziroma ustvarjanju ali spreminjanju sestankov. To podpira dejanja, kot sta predlaganje novih stikov za dodajanje v sistem CRM in prikaz ustreznih informacij upravljanja odnosov s strankami.

**Odkrijte več**
– [Odkrijte, kaj je mogoče s storitvijo Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2259005)
– [Pogosta vprašanja o storitvi Sales FAQ](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
– [Dokumentacija za Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Добијте продајни контекст и могућности тамо где већ радите – да бисте могли да се усредсредите на клијенте, брже их контактирате и унапредите пословне прилике.

Sales доноси агента Sales у Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook и Teams за кориснике апликација Dynamics 365 Sales и Salesforce CRM. Пакет такође обухвата додатну компоненту Dynamics 365 за апликацију Copilot.

Користите Sales за припрему састанака са клијентима, праћење пословних прилика, израду радних верзија релевантних накнадних порука и добијање увида и препорука генерисаних помоћу вештачке интелигенције. Sales се повезује са апликацијом Dynamics 365 Sales или системом Salesforce CRM да би у овим окружењима пружио податке и могућности за продају.

Корисницима Salesforce потребна је лиценца за Microsoft 365 Copilot. Корисницима апликације Dynamics 365 Sales потребна је одговарајућа лиценца за Dynamics 365. Потребно је подешавање које обавља администратор, а приступ одређеним окружењима зависи од лиценце корисника, права и приступа одговарајућем Microsoft производу.

**Подешавање и руковање подацима**

Sales омогућава администраторима и корисницима да приступају садржају и деле податке ван радног оквира Microsoft 365, укључујући услуге за управљање односима са корисницима (CRM) трећих страна. Такво дељење података подлеже одредбама и условима корпорације Microsoft и применљивих услуга за управљање односима са корисницима трећих страна. Дељење података није омогућено док администратори и корисници у вашој организацији не пристану да повежу свој пословни или школски Microsoft налог са својим налогом за управљање односима са корисницима.

Sales у услузи Microsoft 365 Copilot ће имати дозволу да учествује у Microsoft Teams састанцима и прикупља податке са Teams састанка као што су снимци и транскрипти састанака.

Када администратор примени Sales, апликација има дозволу да аутоматски прегледа листе прималаца е-порука и састанака приликом слања е-порука или креирања, односно измене састанака. То омогућава, на пример, предлагање нових контаката за додавање у CRM систем и приказивање релевантних CRM информација.

**Откријте више:**
- [Истражите могућности уз решење Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Најчешћа питања за Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Документација за Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Nabavite prodajni kontekst i izvršavajte radnje tamo gde već radite – da biste mogli da se usredsredite na klijente, brže pratite prodajne prilike i unapređujete prodajne poslove.

Prodaja donosi agenta Sales u Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook i Teams za korisnike aplikacija Dynamics 365 Sales i Salesforce CRM. Paket takođe uključuje dodatnu komponentu Dynamics 365 za aplikaciju Copilot.

Koristite Sales da biste se pripremili za sastanke sa klijentima, bili u toku sa prodajnim poslovima, sastavili radne verzije relevantnih naknadnih poruka i dobili uvide i preporuke generisane pomoću veštačke inteligencije. Sales se povezuje sa aplikacijom Dynamics 365 Sales ili uslugom Salesforce CRM da bi u ovim iskustvima pružio prodajne podatke i funkcionalnosti.

Korisnicima usluge Salesforce potrebna je licenca za Microsoft 365 Copilot. Korisnicima aplikacije Dynamics 365 Sales potrebna je odgovarajuća licenca za Dynamics 365. Potrebno je podešavanje administratora, a pristup određenim iskustvima zavisi od licenciranja korisnika, prava i pristupa relevantnom Microsoft proizvodu.

**Podešavanje i rukovanje podacima**

Sales omogućava administratorima i korisnicima da pristupaju sadržaju i dele podatke van radnog okvira Microsoft 365, uključujući usluge za upravljanje odnosima sa korisnicima (CRM) trećih strana. Takvo deljenje podataka podleže odredbama i uslovima korporacije Microsoft i primenljivih usluga za upravljanje odnosima sa korisnicima trećih strana. Deljenje podataka nije omogućeno dok administratori i korisnici u vašoj organizaciji ne pristanu da povežu svoj poslovni ili školski Microsoft nalog sa svojim nalogom za upravljanje odnosima sa korisnicima.

Prodaja u Microsoft 365 Copilot će imati dozvolu za učešće u Microsoft Teams sastancima i prikupljanje Podataka Teams sastanaka kao što su snimci sastanaka i transkripti.

Kada administrator primeni Sales, on ima dozvolu da automatski pregleda liste primalaca e-poruka i sastanaka prilikom slanja e-poruka ili kreiranja ili izmene sastanaka. To podržava radnje kao što su predlaganje novih kontakata za dodavanje u CRM sistem i prikazivanje relevantnih CRM informacija.

**Otkrijte više:**
- [Istražite mogućnosti uz rešenje Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Najčešća pitanja za prodaju](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dokumentacija za Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Få försäljningskontext och utför åtgärder där du redan arbetar – så att du kan fokusera på kunder, följa upp snabbare och föra affärer framåt.

Sales-agenten blir tillgänglig i Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook och Teams för användare av Dynamics 365 Sales och Salesforce CRM. Paketet innehåller även plugin-programmet Dynamics 365 för Copilot-appen.

Använd Sales när du vill förbereda dig inför kundmöten, få en aktuell överblick över affärer, skapa utkast till relevanta uppföljningar och få AI-genererade insikter och rekommendationer. Sales ansluter till Dynamics 365 Sales eller Salesforce CRM för att tillhandahålla försäljningsdata och funktioner i dessa upplevelser.

Salesforce-användare behöver en Microsoft 365 Copilot-licens. Användare av Dynamics 365 Sales behöver en berättigad Dynamics 365-licens. Administratören måste konfigurera tjänsten, och åtkomsten till specifika upplevelser beror på användarens licens, berättigande och åtkomst till den relevanta Microsoft-produkten.

**Konfiguration och datahantering**

Sales gör det möjligt för administratörer och användare att komma åt innehåll och dela data utanför Microsoft 365, inklusive med CRM-tjänster (Customer Relationship Management) från tredje part. Sådan datadelning omfattas av Microsoft och tillämpliga villkor för CRM från tredje part. Datadelning aktiveras inte förrän administratörer och användare i organisationen samtycker till att ansluta sitt Microsoft-arbets- eller skolkonto till sitt CRM-konto.

Försäljning i Microsoft 365 Copilot har behörighet att delta i Microsoft Teams-möten och samla in Teams-mötesdata, till exempel mötesinspelningar och avskrifter.

När försäljning distribueras av en administratör har de behörighet att automatiskt granska mottagarlistor för e-post och avtalade tider när de skickar e-postmeddelanden eller skapar eller ändrar avtalade tider. Detta stöder åtgärder som att föreslå nya kontakter för tillägg till CRM-systemet och visa relevant CRM-information.

**Upptäck mer:**
- [Utforska vad som är möjligt med Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Vanliga frågor och svar om försäljning](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365-dokumentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
รับบริบทและการดำเนินการด้านการขายได้จากที่ที่คุณทำงานอยู่แล้ว เพื่อให้คุณมุ่งเน้นที่ลูกค้า ติดตามผลได้รวดเร็วยิ่งขึ้น และผลักดันดีลให้คืบหน้า

Sales นำเอเจนต์ Sales มาไว้ใน Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook และ Teams สำหรับผู้ใช้ Dynamics 365 Sales และ Salesforce CRM แพ็กเกจนี้ยังรวมปลั๊กอิน Dynamics 365 Sales สำหรับ Copilot Cowork, Copilot Code และ Microsoft Scout

ใช้ Sales เพื่อเตรียมตัวสำหรับการประชุมกับลูกค้า ติดตามความคืบหน้าของดีล ร่างข้อความติดตามผลที่เกี่ยวข้อง และรับข้อมูลเชิงลึกกับคำแนะนำที่สร้างโดย AI Sales เชื่อมต่อกับ Dynamics 365 Sales หรือ Salesforce CRM เพื่อมอบข้อมูลและความสามารถด้านการขายในประสบการณ์เหล่านี้

ผู้ใช้ Salesforce ต้องมีสิทธิการใช้งาน Microsoft 365 Copilot ส่วนผู้ใช้ Dynamics 365 Sales ต้องมีสิทธิ์การใช้งาน Dynamics 365 ที่เข้าเกณฑ์ ต้องให้ผู้ดูแลระบบตั้งค่า และการเข้าถึงประสบการณ์เฉพาะจะขึ้นอยู่กับสิทธิ์การใช้งาน การให้สิทธิ์ และการเข้าถึงผลิตภัณฑ์ Microsoft ที่เกี่ยวข้องของผู้ใช้

**การตั้งค่าและการจัดการข้อมูล**

การขายช่วยให้ผู้ดูแลระบบและผู้ใช้สามารถเข้าถึงเนื้อหาและแชร์ข้อมูลภายนอก Microsoft 365 รวมถึงบริการการจัดการลูกค้าสัมพันธ์ (CRM) ของบริษัทอื่น การแชร์ข้อมูลดังกล่าวจะขึ้นอยู่กับ Microsoft และข้อกำหนดและเงื่อนไข CRM ของบริษัทอื่นที่เกี่ยวข้อง การแชร์ข้อมูลจะไม่เปิดใช้งานจนกว่าผู้ดูแลระบบและผู้ใช้ในองค์กรของคุณจะยินยอมให้เชื่อมต่อบัญชี Microsoft ของที่ทำงานหรือโรงเรียนกับบัญชี CRM ของพวกเขา

Sales ใน Microsoft 365 Copilot จะมีสิทธิ์เข้าร่วมการประชุม Microsoft Teams และรวบรวมข้อมูลการประชุม Teams เช่น การบันทึกการประชุมและสำเนาบทสนทนา

เมื่อมีการใช้งานโดยผู้ดูแลระบบ Sales จะมีสิทธิ์ในการตรวจสอบรายชื่อผู้รับอีเมลและการนัดหมายโดยอัตโนมัติเมื่อส่งอีเมลหรือสร้างและปรับเปลี่ยนการนัดหมาย ซึ่งช่วยสนับสนุนการดำเนินการต่างๆ เช่น การแนะนำผู้ติดต่อใหม่เพื่อเพิ่มลงในระบบ CRM และการแสดงข้อมูล CRM ที่เกี่ยวข้อง

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Zaten çalıştığınız yerde satış bağlamına ve eylemlerine erişin; böylece müşterilere odaklanabilir, daha hızlı takip yapabilir ve anlaşmaları ilerletebilirsiniz.

Sales, Dynamics 365 Sales ve Salesforce CRM kullanıcıları için Satış aracısını Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook ve Teams'e getiriyor. Paket ayrıca Copilot uygulaması için Dynamics 365 eklentisini içeriyor.

Sales'i müşteri toplantılarına hazırlanmak, anlaşmaları gözden geçirmek, ilgili takip iletilerinin taslağını oluşturmak ve yapay zeka tarafından oluşturulmuş içgörüleri ve önerileri almak için kullanın. Sales, bu deneyimlerde satış verileri ve özellikleri sağlamak için Dynamics 365 Sales'e veya Salesforce CRM'e bağlanır.

Salesforce kullanıcılarının Microsoft 365 Copilot lisansına sahip olması gerekir. Dynamics 365 Sales kullanıcılarının uygun Dynamics 365 lisansına sahip olması gerekir. Yönetici kurulumu gereklidir ve belirli deneyimlere erişim, kullanıcının lisansına, destek hakkına ve ilgili Microsoft ürününe erişimine bağlıdır.

**Kurulum ve veri işleme**

Sales, yöneticilerin ve kullanıcıların üçüncü taraf müşteri ilişkileri yönetimi (CRM) hizmetleri dahil olmak üzere Microsoft 365 dışındaki içeriklere erişmesine ve verileri paylaşmasına olanak sağlar. Bu tür veri paylaşımı Microsoft ve geçerli üçüncü taraf CRM hüküm ve koşullarına tabidir. Kuruluşunuzdaki yöneticiler ve kullanıcılar Microsoft iş veya okul hesaplarını CRM hesaplarına bağlamayı kabul edene kadar veri paylaşımı etkinleştirilmez.

Microsoft 365 Copilot'taki Sales, Microsoft Teams toplantısına katılma ve toplantı kayıtları ve dökümleri gibi Teams toplantı verilerini toplama iznine sahip olur.

Bir yönetici tarafından dağıtıldığında Sales, e-posta gönderirken veya randevu oluştururken ya da değiştirirken e-posta ve randevu alıcı listelerini otomatik olarak gözden geçirme iznine sahip olur. Bu izin, CRM sistemine eklenebilecek yeni kişileri önerme ve ilgili CRM bilgilerini görüntüleme gibi eylemleri destekler.

*Daha fazlasını keşfedin:**
- [Sales ile nelerin mümkün olduğunu keşfedin](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Sales hakkında SSS](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 belgeleri](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Отримуйте контекст і виконуйте дії, пов’язані зі збутом, у тих інструментах, які ви вже використовуєте, щоб зосередитися на клієнтах, швидше виконувати подальші дії та ефективно працювати над угодами.

Програма Sales надає Агенту зі збуту доступ до Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook і Teams для користувачів Dynamics 365 Sales і Salesforce CRM. Пакет також містить плагін Dynamics 365 Sales для Copilot Cowork, Copilot Code і Microsoft Scout.

Використовуйте Sales, щоб готуватися до зустрічей із клієнтами, дізнаватися про перебіг угод, створювати чернетки відповідних подальших дій і отримувати аналітичні висновки й рекомендації ШІ. Sales підключається до Dynamics 365 Sales або Salesforce CRM, щоб надавати дані й функції для збуту в цих середовищах.

Користувачам Salesforce потрібна ліцензія на Microsoft 365 Copilot. Користувачам Dynamics 365 Sales потрібна відповідна ліцензія Dynamics 365. Адміністратор має виконати налаштування, а доступ до певних можливостей залежить від ліцензії користувача, умов обслуговування та доступу до відповідного продукту Microsoft.

**Налаштування й обробка даних**

Програма Sales дає змогу адміністраторам і користувачам отримувати доступ до вмісту й обмінюватися даними за межами Microsoft 365, зокрема зі сторонніми службами керування зв’язками із замовниками (CRM). Такий обмін даними регулюють умови й положення корпорації Майкрософт, а також відповідні умови й положення CRM-систем сторонніх постачальників. Обмін даними не активується, доки адміністратори й користувачі організації не погодяться підключити свій робочий або навчальний обліковий запис Microsoft до облікового запису CRM-системи.

Програма Sales у Microsoft 365 Copilot матиме дозвіл брати участь у нарадах Microsoft Teams і збирати дані нарад Teams, як-от записи та стенограми нарад.

Коли програму Sales розгортає адміністратор, вона матиме дозвіл автоматично перевіряти списки одержувачів електронних листів і зустрічей під час надсилання електронних листів і створення чи редагування зустрічей. Це дає змогу, наприклад, пропонувати нові контакти для додавання до CRM-системи й відображати відповідні відомості CRM.

**Дізнайтеся більше:**
- [Дослідіть можливості Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Запитання й відповіді про Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Документація Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
Nhận bối cảnh và hành động bán hàng ngay nơi bạn làm việc—để bạn có thể tập trung vào khách hàng, theo dõi nhanh hơn và thúc đẩy các thỏa thuận tiến triển.

Dịch vụ Sales mang Trợ lý ảo bán hàng đến với Microsoft 365 Copilot, Outlook và Teams cho người dùng Dynamics 365 Sales và Salesforce CRM. Gói này cũng bao gồm plugin Dynamics 365 Sales dành cho Copilot Cowork, Copilot Code và Microsoft Scout.

Sử dụng Sales để chuẩn bị cho các cuộc họp khách hàng, nắm bắt thông tin về các thỏa thuận, soạn thảo nội dung theo dõi phù hợp và nhận các thông tin chuyên sâu cũng như đề xuất do AI tạo ra. Dịch vụ Sales kết nối với Dynamics 365 Sales hoặc Salesforce CRM để cung cấp dữ liệu bán hàng và các năng lực trong những trải nghiệm này.

Người dùng Salesforce yêu cầu giấy phép Microsoft 365 Copilot. Người dùng Dynamics 365 Sales yêu cầu giấy phép Dynamics 365 đủ điều kiện. Cần có thiết lập của quản trị viên và quyền truy cập vào các trải nghiệm cụ thể phụ thuộc vào giấy phép, quyền hạn và quyền truy cập của người dùng vào sản phẩm Microsoft tương ứng.

**Thiết lập và xử lý dữ liệu**

Dịch vụ Sales cho phép quản trị viên và người dùng truy cập nội dung và chia sẻ dữ liệu bên ngoài Microsoft 365, bao gồm cả các dịch vụ quản lý quan hệ khách hàng (CRM) của bên thứ ba. Việc chia sẻ dữ liệu như vậy tuân theo các điều khoản và điều kiện của Microsoft và CRM bên thứ ba áp dụng. Hệ thống sẽ không chia sẻ dữ liệu cho đến khi người quản trị và người dùng trong tổ chức đồng ý kết nối tài khoản cơ quan hoặc trường học Microsoft của họ với tài khoản CRM.

Dịch vụ Sales trong Microsoft 365 Copilot sẽ có quyền tham gia các cuộc họp Microsoft Teams và thu thập dữ liệu cuộc họp Teams như bản ghi âm, ghi hình và bản chép lời cuộc họp.

Khi được quản trị viên triển khai, dịch vụ Sales sẽ có quyền tự động xem xét danh sách người nhận email và cuộc hẹn khi gửi email hoặc tạo hay sửa đổi cuộc hẹn. Điều này hỗ trợ các hành động như đề xuất liên hệ mới để thêm vào hệ thống CRM và hiển thị thông tin CRM có liên quan.

**Khám phá thêm:**
- [Khám phá những khả năng với dịch vụ Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Câu hỏi thường gặp về dịch vụ Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Tài liệu về Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
在你已经工作的地方获取销售背景信息和行动建议 - 这样你就能专注于客户，更快跟进并推动交易达成。

Sales 将销售智能体引入智能 Microsoft 365 Copilot 副驾驶®、Outlook 和 Teams，供 Dynamics 365 Sales 和 Salesforce CRM 用户使用。该套餐还包括适用于 Copilot Cowork、Copilot Code 和 Microsoft Scout 的 Dynamics 365 Sales 插件。

使用 Sales 准备客户会议、了解交易进展、起草相关的后续跟进内容，并获取 AI 生成的见解和建议。Sales 连接到 Dynamics 365 Sales 或 Salesforce CRM，为这些体验提供销售数据和功能。

Salesforce 用户需要智能 Microsoft 365 Copilot 副驾驶® 许可证。Dynamics 365 Sales 用户需要符合条件的 Dynamics 365 许可证。需要由管理员完成设置。用户能否访问特定体验，取决于其许可证、权利以及对相关 Microsoft 产品的访问权限。

**设置和数据处理**

Sales 允许管理员和用户访问内容并共享 Microsoft 365 之外的数据，包括使用第三方客户关系管理(CRM)服务。此类数据共享受 Microsoft 和适用的第三方 CRM 条款和条件约束。除非组织中的管理员和用户同意将其 Microsoft 工作或学校帐户与其 CRM 帐户连接，否则不会启用数据共享。

智能 Microsoft 365 Copilot 副驾驶® 中的 Sales 将有权参与 Microsoft Teams 会议并收集 Teams 会议数据，例如会议记录和脚本。

当由管理员部署时，Sales 将获得在发送电子邮件或创建、修改约会时自动检查电子邮件和约会收件人列表的权限。这支持建议将新联系人添加到 CRM 系统以及显示相关 CRM 信息等操作。

**发现更多:**
- [探索 Sales 的可能性](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Sales 常见问题解答](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 文档](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)

agentSkills.description: Use when someone asks what happened with an account, opportunity, or contact; needs a deduplicated engagement timeline; or wants engagement changes, commitments, and stakeholder patterns before acting. Not for choosing the next buyer or following up on one meeting.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-activity-synthesis

agentSkills.description: Use to draft a decision-ready business case for one deal or initiative — the customer's baseline problem, the supported impact and cost of inaction, the proposed change and its contribution, and an investment and value case, tailored to a named audience. Produces a reviewable draft; saving or sending requires a separate, explicitly approved action. Not for a price or discount quote, and not for a generic capability pitch.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-business-case-composer

agentSkills.description: Use when a named or suspected competitor must be positioned against customer requirements, decision criteria, or objections for a specific opportunity. Not for generic market research or unsupported competitor claims.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-competitive-strategy

agentSkills.description: Use when a bounded set of sales records needs an evidence-based review for absent, malformed, stale, inconsistent, or unverified data and a proposed correction report. Also applies to an export or supplied table; not for deep reconciliation of one opportunity or team-performance review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-crm-data-hygiene

agentSkills.description: Use when an account needs a phased engagement plan across stakeholders, coverage gaps, relationship paths, and business objectives. Use a 30-day horizon when requested; not for choosing only the immediate next buyer.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-customer-engagement-strategy

agentSkills.description: Use to report what changed and why across a scoped set of deals since a stated baseline — which deals slipped, or what moved on a bounded top set since a point in time. Needs a defined scope and current deal evidence; a baseline improves the comparison, but a current-state result is available without one. Not for ranking what to work on next or a single deal's full standing review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-catchup

agentSkills.description: Use when a deal's product/price configuration needs to be built, judged for fit, or corrected, turned into a quote, and/or advanced to the next business-process stage — including reasoning about whether a proposed configuration is net-new, an expansion, or a renewal, and what it will actually cost.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-desk

agentSkills.description: Use when a seller or manager needs to test an alleged slowdown on one specific opportunity and decide whether it is a supported stall, a record-hygiene issue, or not currently supported by the evidence, then recommend recovery, restructuring, escalation, or disqualification. Not for a change digest across many deals, a leadership status review, cross-set ranking, or an ordinary healthy-deal lookup.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-deal-rescue

agentSkills.description: Use to draft outreach for people the seller met whose pending asks need follow-up, or previously responsive open leads that have gone quiet. Ground drafts in substantive evidence and assess the contact policy for the actual purpose and channel. Produces reviewable text; saving or sending requires a separate, explicitly approved action. Not for a completed meeting's summary and action capture, choosing the next stakeholder, or cold prospecting.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-draft-outreach

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity needs a leadership-ready review of current state, material movement over a defined period, risks, decisions, and a specific leadership ask. Not for a team-wide pipeline review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-executive-deal-review

agentSkills.description: Use when one lead needs an evidence-backed assessment against an explicitly supplied qualification method, including criterion-level gaps, a disposition recommendation, and proposed routing. Not for inventing BANT, forcing a binary decision, or configuring an existing opportunity.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-lead-disposition

agentSkills.description: Use before one customer meeting or sales interaction to prepare an evidence-backed objective, participant brief, relevant context, open commitments, agenda, questions, talking points, risks, and desired outcomes. Works from supplied material; not for post-meeting capture, a phased account plan, or a seller's coaching agenda.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-meeting-prep

agentSkills.description: Use to produce a ranked worklist of which opportunities in a scoped set to work next and why now, weighing value, urgency, risk, momentum, and influenceability. Needs a defined opportunity scope and current opportunity evidence; a live engagement history improves the read but is not required. Not for reporting what changed on a set of deals, a single meeting brief, or a full team pipeline review.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-pipeline-prioritizer

agentSkills.description: Use after one sales meeting or call to separate facts, decisions, commitments, and open topics; propose durable record updates and next actions; and draft follow-up communication when requested. Not for a broad account history or work-period capture.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-post-meeting-follow-up

agentSkills.description: Use when one opportunity's recorded representation needs to be compared with dated business evidence to identify drift, stale or incomplete values, contradictions, and unsupported claims. Works without current record access as a bounded observations report; not for a wide hygiene sweep.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-reconcile-my-opportunity

agentSkills.description: Use when an opportunity must be evaluated against explicit organizational requirements for a defined next stage, with each criterion marked met, unmet, unknown, or conflicting. Not for inferring readiness from a stage label or activity volume.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-stage-advance-readiness

agentSkills.description: turn sales, customer, usage, value, pipeline, and financial data from crm systems, excel workbooks, and other connected sources into one or more executive-ready powerpoint slides. use to visualize data, create charts or scorecards, add data-driven insights to a deck, update existing slides with current metrics, compare customers or periods, explain business performance, or build an executive sales narrative from quantitative data.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-visualize-sales-data

agentSkills.description: Use this skill first for creating a source-grounded internal account brief for a named customer or prospect - what matters to the customer, who matters in the decision, where we stand, which opportunities to validate, and what to do next. Saves an editable PowerPoint deck. Use for requests such as "create an account brief for Northstar", "build a briefing deck on this customer for our sales team", "make an account briefing deck from these notes and filings", or "prepare a prospect brief". Do NOT use for creating login or user accounts, preparing for one upcoming meeting or call unless a deck is asked for, customer-facing sales pitches, QBRs or adoption reviews, annual account plans with quotas or pipeline forecasts, summarizing or fact-checking an existing deck, drawing a reporting hierarchy alone, briefs wanted as a Word, PDF, or Markdown file, or research answered in chat with no brief file requested. For matching tasks, load this skill before any generic PowerPoint/presentation skill.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-account-brief

agentSkills.description: Create a buyer-specific proposal or bid presentation responding to explicit requirements or an RFP, with coverage, evidence, delivery, commercials and limits. Use for "respond to the buyer's requirements" or "prepare our RFP proposal deck". Do NOT use for a proactive customer product or solution pitch, investor pitches, customer business reviews, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-proposal-response

agentSkills.description: Required for general-purpose customer Pitch Decks: cold first meetings, warm-lead product introductions, industry pitches, and internal enablement. Use for "pitch our product to a new buyer" or "introduce our solution". Do NOT use for formal RFPs or buyer-requirement proposals, investor/fundraising pitches, QBRs, account plans, pipeline reports, or edits.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-sales-pitch

agentSkills.description: Use when the user explicitly requests a sales results or forecast summary deck for senior leadership, highlighting expected outcomes, material risks and decisions requiring executive support. Use for "build a sales results deck for our leaders" or "create forecast summary slides for the VP". Do NOT use for forecast or pipeline analysis answered in the conversation, one opportunity's leadership review unless a deck is asked for, deal-by-deal pipeline management, customer-facing business reviews, proactive pitches, or edits to an existing deck.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-create-executive-sales-summary

agentSkills.description: Prepare a seller to handle a specific customer''s likely objections. For each objection: the customer''s wording, discovery questions to ask live, a short evidence-backed response, the proof behind it or the evidence still missing, and a confirming next step. Delivered by default as a separate internal deck, or as removable slides appended to the current deck or kept in chat when the user asks. Use when the user asks to "prep me for this customer''s objections", "how do I answer their pushback on price", "build objection handling for this deal", "what will the buyer push back on and how should I respond", "objection responses for the concerns they raised on the call", or "talk tracks for handling procurement''s objections". Do NOT use to stress-test, score or find weaknesses in a presentation''s own argument, to play devil''s advocate, for general Q&A rehearsal, to write speaker notes or a talk track for the deck itself, or to build or redesign a pitch.
agentSkills.name: d365-sales-prepare-objection-responses

localizedDefinitions.longDescription:
在您平常工作的地方取得銷售內容和執行動作，您因此可專注於客戶、更快跟進，並推動交易進展。

Sales 將 Sales Agent 整合至 Microsoft 365 Copilot、Outlook 和 Teams，供 Dynamics 365 Sales 和 Salesforce CRM 使用者使用。此套件也包含適用於 Copilot 應用程式的 Dynamics 365 外掛程式。

使用 Sales 準備客戶會議、追蹤交易、草擬相關跟進，以及取得 AI 產生的深入解析和建議。Sales 會連線至 Dynamics 365 Sales 或 Salesforce CRM，為這些體驗提供銷售資料和功能。

Salesforce 使用者需要 Microsoft 365 Copilot 授權。Dynamics 365 Sales 使用者需要合格的 Dynamics 365 授權。設定需由系統管理員進行，而是否可存取特定體驗則依據使用者的授權、權利以及對相關 Microsoft 產品的存取權而定。

**設定和資料處理**

Sales 可讓系統管理員與使用者存取 Microsoft 365 以外的內容並共用資料，包括協力廠商客戶關係管理 (CRM) 服務。這類資料共用會受 Microsoft 及適用的第三方 CRM 條款及條件規範。除非貴組織的系統管理員和使用者同意將其公司或學校的 Microsoft 帳戶與其 CRM 帳戶連結，否則不會啟用資料共用。

Microsoft 365 Copilot 中的 Sales 將取得參與 Microsoft Teams 會議的權限，並可收集 Teams 會議資料，例如會議錄製內容和文字記錄。

由系統管理員部署後，Sales 即取得權限，可在傳送電子郵件或建立、修改約會時自動檢閱電子郵件和約會收件者清單。這項功能支援建議將新連絡人新增至 CRM 系統，以及顯示相關 CRM 資訊等動作。

**探索更多。**
- [探索 Sales 的可能性](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- [Sales 常見問題集](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)
- [Dynamics 365 文件](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/)
